objects.definition: typedef int herr_t;
objects.description: Error/status return type for HDF5 APIs. Negative values indicate failure; non-negative indicate success.

objects.definition: typedef bool hbool_t;
objects.description: Deprecated HDF5 boolean typedef mapped to C99 bool. Used as success flags (0/1).

objects.definition: typedef int htri_t;
objects.description: Three-valued boolean used by functions that can return true (>0), false (0), or failure (<0).
Signed version of size_t. Defined here only on Windows (non-MinGW) to provide POSIX-like ssize_t.

objects.definition: typedef uint64_t hsize_t;
objects.description: Unsigned size type used for HDF5 file object sizes and counts (at least 64-bit).
Platform-independent file offset type used by HDF5. int64_t on Windows, off_t otherwise.

objects.definition: typedef int64_t hssize_t;
objects.description: Signed size type (at least 64-bit) used when negative values are needed for sizes.

objects.definition: typedef uint64_t haddr_t;
objects.description: Unsigned address type for object addresses within an HDF5 file (at least 64-bit).
Enumeration of common iteration orders for HDF5 iteration APIs.
Enumeration of index types used when iterating or accessing by index (name or creation order).
Storage info structure containing index and heap sizes; used by object and file info APIs.
Opaque 128-bit token identifying an HDF5 object within a container. Contents are implementation-defined.

objects.definition: typedef void (*H5_atclose_func_t)(void *ctx);
objects.description: Function pointer type for library shutdown callbacks registered with H5atclose().
Alias macro for the attribute iteration callback typedef. This header only selects which versioned typedef name maps to H5A_operator_t; no typedef body is defined here.
Alias macro for the error-stack automatic handler function typedef. This header only maps versioned names to H5E_auto_t; the actual typedef is not defined here.
Alias macro for the error record structure typedef used with H5Ewalk callbacks. Only version mapping is provided; no struct/typedef body in this header.
Alias macro for the error walking callback typedef. The concrete typedef is defined elsewhere; this header just maps versioned names.
Alias macro for the file information struct typedef returned by H5Fget_info. Version selection only; no definition here.
Alias macro for link information struct typedef used by link APIs. Only version mapping is present in this header.
Alias macro for the link iteration callback typedef. Version mapping only; actual typedef defined elsewhere.
Alias macro for object information struct typedef returned by various H5Oget_info* APIs. This file does not define the struct.
Alias macro for the H5O object-iteration callback typedef. Only version mapping is set here.
Alias macro for filter class definition typedef used when registering filters. This header picks the version but does not define the struct/typedef.

Struct describing metadata about an HDF5 attribute: whether a creation order is valid, the creation order index, the character set of the attribute name, and the size in bytes of the raw attribute data.

objects.definition:
typedef herr_t (*H5A_operator2_t)(hid_t location_id /*in*/, const char *attr_name /*in*/,
                                  const H5A_info_t *ainfo /*in*/, void *op_data /*in,out*/);
objects.description: Function pointer type for attribute-iteration callbacks used by H5Aiterate2 and H5Aiterate_by_name. The callback receives the visited object ID, the attribute name, a pointer to attribute info, and user data, and returns <0 to stop with error, 0 to continue, or >0 to short-circuit success.

objects.definition:
typedef herr_t (*H5A_operator1_t)(hid_t location_id /*in*/, const char *attr_name /*in*/,
                                  void *operator_data /*in,out*/);
objects.description: Deprecated function pointer type for legacy attribute-iteration callbacks used by H5Aiterate1. Receives the visited object ID, attribute name, and user data; return semantics mirror H5A_operator2_t.
Enumeration of dataset storage layout kinds for HDF5 datasets (compact, contiguous, chunked, virtual). Used with dataset creation properties. No ownership relationships; plain enum.
Enumeration of internal chunk index data structure types used by HDF5 for chunked dataset indexing.
Enumeration for dataset space allocation timing policy (default, early, late, incremental).
Enumeration reporting whether storage has been allocated for a dataset (none, partial for chunked, or full).
Enumeration controlling when dataset fill values are written (on allocation, never, or if set).
Enumeration for the status/kind of a dataset's fill value (undefined, library default, or user-defined).
Enumeration for Virtual Dataset (VDS) view bounds policy when source data are missing.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5D_append_cb_t)(hid_t dataset_id, hsize_t *cur_dims, void *op_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for append-flush callback used with H5Pset_append_flush; invoked on dimension extension events. The callback returns herr_t and may modify current dims via cur_dims. The lifetime/ownership of op_data is application-defined.

objects.definition:
typedef herr_t (*H5D_operator_t)(void *elem, hid_t type_id, unsigned ndim, const hsize_t *point,
                                 void *operator_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for element-iteration over a memory buffer used by H5Diterate; called once per element in selection.

objects.definition:
typedef herr_t (*H5D_scatter_func_t)(const void **src_buf /*out*/, size_t *src_buf_bytes_used /*out*/,
                                     void *op_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type used by H5Dscatter to supply successive source buffers and byte counts. Returns 0 on success or negative on failure.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5D_gather_func_t)(const void *dst_buf, size_t dst_buf_bytes_used, void *op_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type used by H5Dgather to receive contiguous chunks of gathered data. Returns 0 on success or negative on failure.

objects.definition:
typedef int (*H5D_chunk_iter_op_t)(const hsize_t *offset, unsigned filter_mask, haddr_t addr, hsize_t size,
                                   void *op_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for iterating over chunks in a chunked dataset with H5Dchunk_iter. Return H5_ITER_CONT (0), H5_ITER_STOP (>0), or negative on error.

objects.definition: typedef enum H5E_type_t { H5E_MAJOR, H5E_MINOR } H5E_type_t;
objects.description: Enumeration identifying the kind of error message: major or minor. Used to classify error messages within an error class and when retrieving messages.

Struct describing one error record on an error stack (v2 API). Contains error class and message IDs, source location, and optional description. Instances are provided to user callbacks during stack walking.
Enumeration controlling traversal order when walking an error stack: from innermost to API (UPWARD) or API to innermost (DOWNWARD).

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5E_walk2_t)(unsigned n, const H5E_error2_t *err_desc, void *client_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for v2 error stack walk callbacks used by H5Ewalk2(). Receives the index, const pointer to H5E_error2_t, and user data.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5E_auto2_t)(hid_t estack, void *client_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for v2 automatic error reporting callbacks used with H5Eset_auto2()/H5Eget_auto2(). Called with an error stack ID and user data.

objects.definition: typedef hid_t H5E_major_t;
objects.description: Deprecated typedef aliasing hid_t to represent a major error identifier in the v1 (deprecated) API.

objects.definition: typedef hid_t H5E_minor_t;
objects.description: Deprecated typedef aliasing hid_t to represent a minor error identifier in the v1 (deprecated) API.
Deprecated v1 API struct describing an error record (without class ID). Used by legacy traversal and printing functions.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5E_walk1_t)(int n, H5E_error1_t *err_desc, void *client_data);
objects.description: Deprecated function pointer type for legacy error stack walk callbacks used by H5Ewalk1(). Provides mutable H5E_error1_t to callback.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5E_auto1_t)(void *client_data);
objects.description: Deprecated function pointer type for legacy automatic error printing/reporting used with H5Eset_auto1()/H5Eget_auto1().
Enumeration indicating the scope of certain file operations (e.g., H5Fflush): limit to a single file handle or include mounted files (global).
Enumeration controlling file close semantics when multiple identifiers or open objects exist.
Structured description of global file information: superblock details, free space manager stats, and shared object header message info. Used with H5Fget_info2().

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5F_mem_t {
    H5FD_MEM_NOLIST = -1,
    H5FD_MEM_DEFAULT = 0,
    H5FD_MEM_SUPER = 1,
    H5FD_MEM_BTREE = 2,
    H5FD_MEM_DRAW  = 3,
    H5FD_MEM_GHEAP = 4,
    H5FD_MEM_LHEAP = 5,
    H5FD_MEM_OHDR  = 6,

    H5FD_MEM_NTYPES
} H5F_mem_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of file memory allocation types used by VFD/allocator and free space managers. Values may be persisted in files.
Simple struct describing a free-space section: its file address and size. Used with H5Fget_free_sections().

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5F_libver_t {
    H5F_LIBVER_ERROR    = -1,
    H5F_LIBVER_EARLIEST = 0,
    H5F_LIBVER_V18      = 1,
    H5F_LIBVER_V110     = 2,
    H5F_LIBVER_V112     = 3,
    H5F_LIBVER_V114     = 4,
    H5F_LIBVER_V200     = 5,
    H5F_LIBVER_LATEST   = 5,
    H5F_LIBVER_NBOUNDS
} H5F_libver_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of library format version bounds used for object storage; select earliest/latest compatibility. Note: LATEST is an alias of V200 here.
Enumeration of file free space handling strategies (free-space managers, paged aggregation, aggregators, or none).
Deprecated (since 1.10.1) enum for legacy file space strategy selection used around release 1.10.0.

Holds histograms of metadata read retry counts (by type) for checksum-protected metadata under SWMR; used with H5Fget_metadata_read_retry_info(). Caller must free any non-NULL retries[i] buffers allocated by the library.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5F_flush_cb_t)(hid_t object_id, void *udata);
objects.description: Function pointer type for file/object flush callbacks set via H5Pset_object_flush_cb() on a FAPL.
Deprecated predecessor of H5F_info2_t containing limited global file info: superblock extension size and shared object header message info. Used with deprecated H5Fget_info1().
Enumeration describing how links in a group are stored: unknown, legacy symbol table, compact in object header, or dense (fractal heap + v2 B-tree). Used in group info queries.
Struct returned by H5Gget_info* calls with metadata about a group: link storage type, number of links, maximum creation order, and whether a file is mounted on the group.

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5G_obj_t {
    H5G_UNKNOWN = -1, /**< Unknown object type		*/
    H5G_GROUP,        /**< Object is a group		*/
    H5G_DATASET,      /**< Object is a dataset		*/
    H5G_TYPE,         /**< Object is a named data type	*/
    H5G_LINK,         /**< Object is a symbolic link	*/
    H5G_UDLINK,       /**< Object is a user-defined link */
    H5G_RESERVED_5,   /**< Reserved for future use	*/
    H5G_RESERVED_6,   /**< Reserved for future use	*/
    H5G_RESERVED_7    /**< Reserved for future use	*/
} H5G_obj_t;
objects.description: Deprecated enumeration for runtime object type classification used by older group APIs.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5G_iterate_t)(hid_t group, const char *name, void *op_data);
objects.description: Deprecated callback function type used by H5Giterate() to visit group members.

Deprecated struct returning information about an object (file/object numbers, hard link count, object type, modification time, link value length, and object header info). Note: field H5O_stat_t is defined in H5Opublic.h and not documented here.

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5I_type_t {
    H5I_UNINIT = (-2),
    H5I_BADID  = (-1),
    H5I_FILE   = 1,
    H5I_GROUP,
    H5I_DATATYPE,
    H5I_DATASPACE,
    H5I_DATASET,
    H5I_MAP,
    H5I_ATTR,
    H5I_VFL,
    H5I_VOL,
    H5I_GENPROP_CLS,
    H5I_GENPROP_LST,
    H5I_ERROR_CLASS,
    H5I_ERROR_MSG,
    H5I_ERROR_STACK,
    H5I_SPACE_SEL_ITER,
    H5I_EVENTSET,
    H5I_NTYPES
} H5I_type_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of library identifier (ID) type codes used by HDF5 to categorize identifiers (files, groups, datatypes, etc.). Values include sentinels like H5I_UNINIT and H5I_BADID and concrete categories (H5I_FILE, H5I_GROUP, ...). Used with APIs such as H5Iregister, H5Iget_type, and ID-type management functions.

objects.definition: typedef int64_t hid_t;
objects.description: Primary HDF5 handle/identifier type returned by most HDF5 object-opening/creation calls. It is a signed 64-bit integer. Negative values indicate invalid IDs or errors. Not directly constructed here; obtained from other HDF5 module APIs. Use H5Iis_valid and H5Iget_type to query status/type.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5I_free_t)(void *obj, void **request);
objects.description: Function pointer type for per-object free callbacks associated with an ID type. Implementations should free the object pointed to by obj and may optionally produce or update an asynchronous request via request. Return non-negative on success; negative to keep the object in the ID type. Called by H5Iclear_type and H5Idestroy_type, not by H5Iremove_verify.

objects.definition: typedef int (*H5I_search_func_t)(void *obj, hid_t id, void *key);
objects.description: Function pointer type for search predicates used by H5Isearch. Should return non-zero if the object identified by id and pointed to by obj matches the search criteria described by key; return 0 otherwise.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5I_iterate_func_t)(hid_t id, void *udata);
objects.description: Function pointer type for iteration callbacks used by H5Iiterate. Called for each member ID in a type, receiving the ID and user data. Return >0 to stop and have H5Iiterate return that value, 0 to continue, <0 to signal failure.

Enumeration of link class types used by the HDF5 link (H5L) API. Values < 64 are reserved for internal use; 64–255 are user-defined classes. Persisted in files, so values are stable. Common values include HARD, SOFT, and EXTERNAL.

Information structure returned by newer H5L APIs about a link. Contains link type, optional creation order info, link name character set, and either target object token (for hard links) or value size (for soft/user-defined).

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5L_iterate2_t)(hid_t group, const char *name, const H5L_info2_t *info, void *op_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for link iteration callbacks used by H5Literate2/H5Lvisit2 and their _by_name variants. Implementations inspect the passed group, link name, link info, and user data and return herr_t to control iteration.
Callback function pointer type for customizing traversal of external links. Can adjust access flags and FAPL when opening the target file/object.
Deprecated (1.12) link information structure used by older H5L APIs. Similar to H5L_info2_t but for hard links stores on-disk address instead of token.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5L_iterate1_t)(hid_t group, const char *name, const H5L_info1_t *info, void *op_data);
objects.description: Deprecated (1.12) function pointer type for iteration callbacks paired with H5L_info1_t, used by H5Literate1/H5Lvisit1 APIs.
Enumeration of operation selectors for the VOL map GET callback, covering retrieval of map access/creation property lists, key/value datatypes, and key-value pair count.
Enumeration of operation selectors for the VOL map SPECIFIC callback, supporting iterate and delete operations on a map.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5M_iterate_t)(hid_t map_id, const void *key, void *op_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for user iteration callbacks used by H5Miterate and related APIs. The callback receives the map ID, the current key buffer (typed by the provided key memory datatype), and an opaque user pointer, and returns a herr_t to control iteration.

Tagged-union parameter bundle passed to the HDF5 VOL optional callback interface for map-related operations. It provides per-operation structs for create, open, get_val, exists, put, get (with nested union for specific GETs), specific (with nested union for iterate and delete). Many fields reference external HDF5 core types (hid_t, hsize_t, H5VL_loc_params_t).
Enumeration of HDF5 object kinds (group, dataset, named datatype, map). Used throughout the H5O API to report or select an object's basic type.
Describes object header metadata for an HDF5 object, including counts, flags, space usage, and message presence/share bitmaps.
Version-3 public object information record returned by H5Oget_info3 and related routines; contains file number, object token, type, refcount, times, and attribute count.
Native-format introspection info for an object, including object header info and estimated sizes of associated index/heaps for the object and its attributes.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t H5O_msg_crt_idx_t;
objects.description: Unsigned integer type for object header message creation indexes.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5O_iterate2_t)(hid_t obj, const char *name, const H5O_info2_t *info, void *op_data);
objects.description: Callback function pointer type for H5Ovisit3/H5Ovisit_by_name3 iteration (version 3); receives the current object, its relative name, info, and user data.
Return codes for committed datatype merge-search callback used during object copy; controls whether to abort, continue global search, or stop search but continue copying.

objects.definition: typedef H5O_mcdt_search_ret_t (*H5O_mcdt_search_cb_t)(void *op_data);
objects.description: Callback type invoked after searching for a matching committed datatype during H5Ocopy merge handling; returns an H5O_mcdt_search_ret_t.
Deprecated struct formerly embedded in H5G_stat_t; summarizes basic object header size, free space, and counts.
Deprecated object information struct (versions 1/2 of API). Superset including address and embedded header/meta_size; returned by deprecated H5Oget_info[1|2] and friends.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5O_iterate1_t)(hid_t obj, const char *name, const H5O_info1_t *info, void *op_data);
objects.description: Deprecated iteration callback type used with H5Ovisit1/2 and H5Ovisit_by_name1/2; receives info as H5O_info1_t.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_cls_create_func_t)(hid_t prop_id, void *create_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for a property list class create callback, invoked when a new property list of the class is created.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_cls_copy_func_t)(hid_t new_prop_id, hid_t old_prop_id, void *copy_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for a property list class copy callback, invoked when a property list of the class is copied.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_cls_close_func_t)(hid_t prop_id, void *close_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for a property list class close callback, invoked when a property list of the class is closed.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_prp_cb1_t)(const char *name, size_t size, void *value);
objects.description: Generic property callback signature used for create, copy, and close operations on a property value (name/size/value triple). Aliased for specific stages: create, copy, and close.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_prp_cb2_t)(hid_t prop_id, const char *name, size_t size, void *value);
objects.description: Generic property callback signature used for set, get, and delete operations; includes the property list id along with name/size/value.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_prp_encode_func_t)(const void *value, void **buf, size_t *size);
objects.description: Function pointer for encoding a property value into a buffer. There is currently no public API exposing this callback.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_prp_decode_func_t)(const void **buf, void *value);
objects.description: Function pointer for decoding a property value from a buffer. There is currently no public API exposing this callback.

objects.definition: typedef int (*H5P_prp_compare_func_t)(const void *value1, const void *value2, size_t size);
objects.description: Comparison function for property values; returns positive/negative/zero for greater/less/equal.

objects.definition: typedef herr_t (*H5P_iterate_t)(hid_t id, const char *name, void *iter_data);
objects.description: Iterator callback type used with H5Piterate() to visit each property in a list or class.
Enum reporting the chunk optimization scheme actually used for parallel I/O on chunked datasets.
Enum reporting the actual I/O mode used for a parallel I/O call (independent, collective, mixed, etc.).

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5D_mpio_no_collective_cause_t {
    H5D_MPIO_COLLECTIVE = 0x00,
    H5D_MPIO_SET_INDEPENDENT = 0x01,
    H5D_MPIO_DATATYPE_CONVERSION = 0x02,
    H5D_MPIO_DATA_TRANSFORMS = 0x04,
    H5D_MPIO_MPI_OPT_TYPES_ENV_VAR_DISABLED = 0x08,
    H5D_MPIO_NOT_SIMPLE_OR_SCALAR_DATASPACES = 0x10,
    H5D_MPIO_NOT_CONTIGUOUS_OR_CHUNKED_DATASET = 0x20,
    H5D_MPIO_PARALLEL_FILTERED_WRITES_DISABLED = 0x40,
    H5D_MPIO_ERROR_WHILE_CHECKING_COLLECTIVE_POSSIBLE = 0x80,
    H5D_MPIO_NO_SELECTION_IO = 0x100,
    H5D_MPIO_NO_COLLECTIVE_MAX_CAUSE = 0x200
} H5D_mpio_no_collective_cause_t;
objects.description: Enum bitfield for causes why collective I/O was not performed on a parallel I/O call.
Enum to control or report whether selection I/O (or vector I/O) is enabled for dataset transfer operations.

Enumeration of HDF5 reference kinds. Includes legacy object/region values (OBJECT1/DATASET_REGION1), current object/region values (OBJECT2/DATASET_REGION2), attribute references, and sentinels. Order and values are ABI-encoded and must not change.

objects.definition: typedef haddr_t hobj_ref_t;
objects.description: Deprecated typedef for an object reference payload used by legacy reference APIs. It aliases haddr_t and is valid only with the native VOL connector. Construction and interpretation are via deprecated H5R* APIs that accept void*/hobj_ref_t.
Deprecated dataset region reference buffer used with legacy reference APIs. Struct wraps an opaque byte array large enough to hold an address and index in legacy format. Only for native VOL.

Current opaque reference container used uniformly for object, dataset region, and attribute references. Holds an opaque byte buffer with alignment padding. Instances are created, copied, and destroyed via the H5R* API in this header.
Enumeration of dataspace classes in HDF5: invalid/no class, scalar, simple (regular grid), or null (empty). Used to create or query a dataspace’s class.

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5S_seloper_t {
    H5S_SELECT_NOOP = -1, /**< Error \since 1.0.0                        */
    H5S_SELECT_SET  = 0,  /**< Select "set" operation \since 1.0.0       */
    H5S_SELECT_OR,        /**< Binary "or" operation for hyperslabs ... */
    H5S_SELECT_AND,       /**< Binary "and" operation for hyperslabs ... */
    H5S_SELECT_XOR,       /**< Binary "xor" operation for hyperslabs ... */
    H5S_SELECT_NOTB,      /**< Binary "not" operation for hyperslabs ... */
    H5S_SELECT_NOTA,      /**< Binary "not" operation for hyperslabs ... */
    H5S_SELECT_APPEND,    /**< Append elements to end of point selection \since 1.4.0 */
    H5S_SELECT_PREPEND,   /**< Prepend elements to beginning of point selection \since 1.4.0 */
    H5S_SELECT_INVALID    /**< Invalid upper bound on selection operations \since 1.0.0 */
} H5S_seloper_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of selection combination operators for dataspaces (set/union/intersection/xor/differences and list append/prepend). Used by selection APIs.
Enumeration describing the current selection type within a dataspace (none, points, hyperslabs, all). Returned by H5Sget_select_type.

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5T_class_t {
    H5T_NO_CLASS  = -1, /**< error                                   */
    H5T_INTEGER   = 0,  /**< integer types                           */
    H5T_FLOAT     = 1,  /**< floating-point types                    */
    H5T_TIME      = 2,  /**< date and time types                     */

    H5T_NCLASSES /**< sentinel: this must be last             */
} H5T_class_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of HDF5 datatype classes (atomic and derived). Used with H5T APIs to query and create types.
Enumeration of byte orders for atomic and some derived datatypes.
Enumeration of integer sign representation for HDF5 integer types.
Enumeration of floating-point mantissa normalization schemes.

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5T_cset_t {
    H5T_CSET_ERROR       = -1, /**< error                           */
    H5T_CSET_ASCII       = 0,  /**< US ASCII                        */
    H5T_CSET_UTF8        = 1,  /**< UTF-8 Unicode encoding		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_2  = 2,  /**< reserved for later use		     */

    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_5  = 5,  /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_6  = 6,  /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_7  = 7,  /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_8  = 8,  /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_9  = 9,  /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_10 = 10, /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_11 = 11, /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_12 = 12, /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_13 = 13, /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_14 = 14, /**< reserved for later use		     */
    H5T_CSET_RESERVED_15 = 15  /**< reserved for later use		     */
} H5T_cset_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of character set encodings for string datatypes (ASCII and UTF-8 defined).

objects.definition:
typedef enum H5T_str_t {
    H5T_STR_ERROR       = -1, /**< error                           */
    H5T_STR_NULLTERM    = 0,  /**< null terminate like in C        */
    H5T_STR_NULLPAD     = 1,  /**< pad with nulls                  */
    H5T_STR_SPACEPAD    = 2,  /**< pad with spaces like in Fortran */

functions.name: H5open
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5open(void);
functions.description: Initializes the HDF5 library. Typically happens automatically on first HDF5 API call; safe to call multiple times to ensure the library is initialized.
requirements: May be called at any time; safe to call more than once.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure. (herr_t semantics)

functions.name: H5atclose
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5atclose(H5_atclose_func_t func, void *ctx);
functions.description: Registers a callback to be invoked by the HDF5 library when it is closing. Callbacks are invoked in LIFO order; full HDF5 functionality is available from within the callback. The ctx pointer is passed through to the callback.
requirements: func must be a valid, non-NULL function pointer of type void (*)(void *).
ctx may be NULL.
If the library is initialized and closed more than once, the callback must be (re)registered in each open/close cycle.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5close
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5close(void);
functions.description: Flushes all data to disk, closes all open HDF5 objects, and frees library resources, effectively shutting down the library. Usually called automatically at process exit but can be called earlier.
requirements: Calling this will close all open HDF5 objects and release library memory.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5dont_atexit
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5dont_atexit(void);
functions.description: Instructs the library not to install an atexit() cleanup routine. Used when the library may be unloaded before process exit to avoid calling into unmapped code.
requirements: Must be called before any other HDF5 function calls in the process.
Must be called each time the library is loaded/linked into the application (first time and after it has been unloaded).
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5garbage_collect
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5garbage_collect(void);
functions.description: Runs garbage collection on all internal free lists, freeing any unused memory held by the library. Optional utility to reduce peak memory usage after heavy allocations.
requirements: No specific preconditions; may be called at any time.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5set_free_list_limits
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5set_free_list_limits(int reg_global_lim, int reg_list_lim, int arr_global_lim, int arr_list_lim, int blk_global_lim, int blk_list_lim);
functions.description: Sets global and per-list size limits (in bytes) on the library’s internal memory free lists (regular, array, block, and factory). Using -1 disables the limit for that category. Block limits also apply to factory free lists.
requirements: Each limit parameter must be either -1 (no limit) or a non-negative integer byte count.
Limits apply globally to the entire process/library instance.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5get_free_list_sizes
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5get_free_list_sizes(size_t *reg_size, size_t *arr_size, size_t *blk_size, size_t *fac_size);
functions.description: Retrieves the current sizes (in bytes) of the library’s internal free lists: regular, array, block, and factory.
requirements: reg_size, arr_size, blk_size, and fac_size must be valid, non-NULL pointers to writable size_t storage.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5get_libversion
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5get_libversion(unsigned *majnum, unsigned *minnum, unsigned *relnum);
functions.description: Returns the major, minor, and release version numbers of the linked HDF5 library.
requirements: majnum, minnum, and relnum must be valid, non-NULL pointers to writable unsigned storage.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5check_version
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5check_version(unsigned majnum, unsigned minnum, unsigned relnum);
functions.description: Verifies that the compile-time HDF5 version (passed in) matches the version of the linked HDF5 library. On mismatch, the function calls abort() after printing diagnostic information; on success, it may also check additional consistency and print a warning if inconsistent but continue.
requirements: majnum, minnum, relnum should match the library’s compile-time macros; typically invoked via the H5check() macro.
Be aware that version mismatches will cause the application to abort via abort().
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure (but primary mismatch path aborts).

functions.name: H5is_library_terminating
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5is_library_terminating(bool *is_terminating);
functions.description: Indicates whether the HDF5 library is currently in the process of shutting down. The flag is only true during shutdown; false before initialization, during normal operation, and after close. Value is undefined on failure.
requirements: is_terminating must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to writable bool storage.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5is_library_threadsafe
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5is_library_threadsafe(bool *is_ts);
functions.description: Reports whether the linked HDF5 library was built with thread-safety (global mutex protection) enabled.
requirements: is_ts must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to writable bool storage.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5free_memory
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5free_memory(void *mem);
functions.description: Frees memory that was allocated by the HDF5 library on behalf of the caller or by H5allocate_memory()/H5resize_memory(). Safe to pass NULL. Especially important on Windows to avoid cross-DLL heap issues.
requirements: mem may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must point to memory allocated by the HDF5 library (e.g., via H5allocate_memory(), H5resize_memory(), or an HDF5 API that returns an allocated buffer).
Do not use this function to free memory allocated by non-HDF5 allocators.
Returns non-negative on success; negative on failure.

functions.name: H5allocate_memory
functions.signature: H5_DLL void *H5allocate_memory(size_t size, bool clear);
functions.description: Allocates a memory buffer using the HDF5 library’s allocator, intended for buffers that will later be freed internally by the library (e.g., from third-party filters). If clear is true, the buffer is zero-initialized. Returns NULL on failure or when size is 0.
requirements: size is the requested size in bytes; if size == 0, the function returns NULL.
The returned pointer, if non-NULL, must be freed with H5free_memory() (or may be released via H5resize_memory(ptr, 0)).
clear controls initialization: true -> zero-filled; false -> uninitialized.

functions.name: H5resize_memory
functions.signature: H5_DLL void *H5resize_memory(void *mem, size_t size);
functions.description: Resizes or reallocates a buffer previously allocated with H5allocate_memory() using the library’s allocator. If size is 0, the buffer is freed and NULL is returned. If mem is NULL and size > 0, a new buffer is allocated. Returns NULL on failure.
requirements: mem must be NULL or a pointer previously allocated by H5allocate_memory().
If size == 0, the pointed-to memory (if any) is freed using the HDF5 allocator and NULL is returned.
If size > 0 and reallocation succeeds, the returned pointer (which may differ from mem) must later be freed with H5free_memory().
Do not pass pointers allocated by non-HDF5 allocators.

functions.name: H5Aclose
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aclose(hid_t attr_id);
functions.description: Closes an open attribute identified by attr_id and releases the identifier. Use after finishing all I/O on the attribute.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier previously obtained (e.g., from H5Acreate*, H5Aopen*).
Do not use attr_id after successful close.
Call exactly once per open attribute to avoid resource leaks.

functions.name: H5Aclose_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aclose_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t attr_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously closes an attribute. The app_* parameters are automatically supplied by macros; es_id identifies the event set for the async operation.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier for asynchronous operations.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically provided by the H5Aclose_async macro; when calling directly, they should describe the call site.
Do not use attr_id after the close operation completes.

functions.name: H5Acreate2
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Acreate2(hid_t loc_id, const char *attr_name, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t acpl_id, hid_t aapl_id);
functions.description: Creates a new attribute named attr_name attached to the object identified by loc_id, with datatype type_id and dataspace space_id. Returns a new attribute identifier that must be closed with H5Aclose.
requirements: loc_id must identify a valid object (file, group, dataset, or named datatype). If a file identifier is used, the attribute is attached to the file’s root group.
attr_name must be unique on the target object and a valid, null-terminated string.
type_id must be a valid datatype identifier; the returned datatype will be read-only when obtained via H5Aget_type.
space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier compatible with the attribute’s data.
acpl_id must be a valid attribute creation property list identifier; aapl_id is unused.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Acreate_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Acreate_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *attr_name, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t acpl_id, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously creates an attribute attached to the object at loc_id. Returns an attribute identifier; completion is associated with es_id. app_* are call-site metadata supplied by macros.
requirements: loc_id must identify a valid object.
attr_name must be unique on the object and a valid string.
type_id and space_id must be valid and compatible.
acpl_id must be a valid attribute creation property list; aapl_id is unused.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier for asynchronous operations.
The returned attribute identifier must later be closed with H5Aclose().
app_file, app_func, app_line are normally supplied by the H5Acreate_async macro.

functions.name: H5Acreate_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Acreate_by_name(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t acpl_id, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Creates a new attribute attr_name on the object located at obj_name relative to loc_id. Allows specifying link access properties via lapl_id. Returns an attribute identifier to be closed with H5Aclose.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location in the file containing the target object.
obj_name must be a valid path (relative to loc_id or absolute) to the target object.
attr_name must be unique on the target object and a valid string.
type_id and space_id must be valid and compatible for the attribute.
acpl_id must be a valid attribute creation property list; aapl_id is unused.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Acreate_by_name_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Acreate_by_name_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t acpl_id, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t lapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously creates an attribute attr_name on the object named obj_name relative to loc_id. Completion is tracked by es_id; app_* are call-site metadata.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to a valid object relative to loc_id (or absolute).
attr_name must be unique and valid.
type_id and space_id must be valid and compatible.
acpl_id valid; aapl_id unused; lapl_id valid if non-default.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically supplied by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Adelete
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Adelete(hid_t loc_id, const char *attr_name);
functions.description: Deletes the attribute named attr_name from the object identified by loc_id.
requirements: loc_id must identify the object that currently has the attribute.
attr_name must be a valid attribute name present on the object.
Do not use this function when other attribute identifiers are open on loc_id; doing so may change attribute indexes and lead to incorrect results for those open attributes.

functions.name: H5Adelete_by_idx
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Adelete_by_idx(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, hsize_t n, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Deletes an attribute from the object at obj_name (relative to loc_id) by its position n within the specified index (idx_type) and traversal order (order).
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object relative to loc_id (or absolute).
idx_type must be a valid attribute index type.
order must be a valid iteration order.
n must be a valid offset within the chosen index; it identifies which attribute to delete.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.

functions.name: H5Adelete_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Adelete_by_name(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Deletes the attribute named attr_name from the object at obj_name relative to loc_id.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object relative to loc_id (or absolute).
attr_name must be a valid name on the target object.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.

functions.name: H5Aexists
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Aexists(hid_t obj_id, const char *attr_name);
functions.description: Checks whether an attribute named attr_name exists on the object identified by obj_id. Returns a tri-state value.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid object identifier.
attr_name must be a valid attribute name string.

functions.name: H5Aexists_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aexists_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t obj_id, const char *attr_name, bool *exists, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously determines whether an attribute exists on an object. The result is written to *exists when the operation completes; es_id is the event set for the operation.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid object identifier.
attr_name must be a valid attribute name string.
exists must be a valid non-null pointer to receive the boolean result.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically provided by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Aexists_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Aexists_by_name(hid_t obj_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Checks whether attr_name exists on the object specified by obj_name relative to obj_id (location).
requirements: obj_id must be a valid location in the file.
obj_name must resolve to a target object relative to obj_id (or absolute).
attr_name must be a valid attribute name string.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.

functions.name: H5Aexists_by_name_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aexists_by_name_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, bool *exists, hid_t lapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously checks for existence of attr_name on the object obj_name relative to loc_id. Writes result to *exists; uses lapl_id for link access and es_id for async tracking.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to a target object (relative or absolute).
attr_name must be a valid attribute name string.
exists must be a non-null pointer to a bool to receive the result.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically supplied by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Aget_create_plist
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aget_create_plist(hid_t attr_id);
functions.description: Returns a copy of the creation property list for the attribute identified by attr_id. The returned property list must be closed with H5Pclose.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
The returned property list identifier must be closed with H5Pclose() to avoid resource leaks.

functions.name: H5Aget_info
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aget_info(hid_t attr_id, H5A_info_t *ainfo);
functions.description: Retrieves information (such as creation order, cset, and data size) about the attribute identified by attr_id and stores it in *ainfo.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
ainfo must be a valid non-null pointer to H5A_info_t for output.

functions.name: H5Aget_info_by_idx
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aget_info_by_idx(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, hsize_t n, H5A_info_t *ainfo, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Retrieves information for the attribute at position n within the specified index of the object obj_name relative to loc_id. Results are stored in *ainfo.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
idx_type must be a valid index type; order must be a valid iteration order.
n specifies the attribute’s position within the chosen index and must be within bounds.
ainfo must be a valid non-null pointer for output.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.

functions.name: H5Aget_info_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aget_info_by_name(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, H5A_info_t *ainfo, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Retrieves information about the named attribute attr_name attached to the object at obj_name relative to loc_id and writes it to *ainfo.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
attr_name must be a valid attribute name on that object.
ainfo must be a valid non-null pointer for output.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.

functions.name: H5Aget_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Aget_name(hid_t attr_id, size_t buf_size, char *buf);
functions.description: Retrieves the name of the attribute identified by attr_id into buf (up to buf_size bytes). Returns the full length of the attribute name, which may exceed buf_size.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
buf must point to a writable buffer of at least buf_size bytes when buf_size > 0.
Caller should handle the case where the returned length is greater than buf_size (indicating truncation).

functions.name: H5Aget_name_by_idx
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Aget_name_by_idx(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, hsize_t n, char *name, size_t size, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Retrieves the name of the attribute at position n within the specified index of the object obj_name relative to loc_id. Writes up to size bytes into name and returns the full name length.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
idx_type must be a valid index type; order must be a valid iteration order.
n must be a valid index position.
name must point to a writable buffer of at least size bytes when size > 0.
Caller should handle the case where returned length exceeds size (truncation).
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.

functions.name: H5Aget_space
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aget_space(hid_t attr_id);
functions.description: Returns a copy of the dataspace of the attribute identified by attr_id. The returned dataspace identifier must be closed with H5Sclose.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
The returned dataspace identifier must be closed with H5Sclose() to avoid resource leaks.

functions.name: H5Aget_storage_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL hsize_t H5Aget_storage_size(hid_t attr_id);
functions.description: Returns the amount of storage (in bytes) required to store the specified attribute. Returns 0 on failure.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.

functions.name: H5Aget_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aget_type(hid_t attr_id);
functions.description: Returns a copy of the attribute’s datatype. Named types are reopened before returning. Returned datatypes are read-only and must be closed with H5Tclose.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
The returned datatype identifier must be closed with H5Tclose() to avoid resource leaks.
Returned datatype is read-only.

functions.name: H5Aiterate2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aiterate2(hid_t loc_id, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, hsize_t *idx, H5A_operator2_t op, void *op_data);
functions.description: Iterates over attributes attached to the object identified by loc_id, in the specified index and order, starting at *idx. Calls user callback op for each attribute. Modifying attributes during iteration leads to undefined behavior.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier.
idx_type must be a valid index type; order must be a valid iteration order.
idx must be a valid pointer to the starting position and will be updated to the next position; details on permitting NULL are unknown from this header.
op must be a valid callback of type H5A_operator2_t; it must follow the documented return-value conventions (negative to stop with failure, positive to short-circuit success, zero to continue).
Do not add or remove attributes to/from the object during iteration; behavior is undefined.

functions.name: H5Aiterate_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aiterate_by_name(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, hsize_t *idx, H5A_operator2_t op, void *op_data, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Iterates over attributes of the object at obj_name relative to loc_id using the specified index and order, starting at *idx, calling op for each attribute. Modifying attributes during iteration is undefined.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
idx_type must be a valid index type; order must be a valid iteration order.
idx must be a valid pointer to the starting position and will be updated; allowance for NULL is unknown from this header.
op must be a valid H5A_operator2_t callback adhering to the documented return-value conventions.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.
Do not add or remove attributes during iteration; behavior is undefined.

functions.name: H5Aopen
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen(hid_t obj_id, const char *attr_name, hid_t aapl_id);
functions.description: Opens an existing attribute named attr_name attached to the object identified by obj_id. Returns an attribute identifier that must be closed with H5Aclose.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid object identifier.
attr_name must be an existing attribute name on the object.
aapl_id is unused.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Aopen_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t obj_id, const char *attr_name, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously opens an existing attribute on obj_id. Returns an attribute identifier; completion is tracked by es_id. app_* identify the call site.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid object identifier.
attr_name must be the name of an existing attribute.
aapl_id is unused.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier for asynchronous operations.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose() when no longer needed.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically supplied by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Aopen_by_idx
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen_by_idx(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, hsize_t n, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Opens the attribute at position n in the specified index and order on the object obj_name relative to loc_id. Returns an attribute identifier to be closed with H5Aclose.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object relative to loc_id (or absolute).
idx_type must be a valid index type; order must be a valid iteration order.
n must be a valid index position for the object’s attributes.
aapl_id is unused; lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Aopen_by_idx_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen_by_idx_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, hsize_t n, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t lapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously opens the attribute at index position n on the object obj_name relative to loc_id. Returns an attribute identifier; operation is tracked by es_id.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
idx_type and order must be valid.
n must be a valid attribute index position.
aapl_id unused; lapl_id valid if non-default.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically provided by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Aopen_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen_by_name(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Opens an existing attribute named attr_name on the object at obj_name relative to loc_id. Returns an attribute identifier that must be closed with H5Aclose.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
attr_name must be a valid existing attribute name on that object.
aapl_id is unused; lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Aopen_by_name_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen_by_name_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *attr_name, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t lapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously opens an existing attribute named attr_name on the object obj_name relative to loc_id. Returns an attribute identifier; completion is tracked by es_id.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
attr_name must be an existing attribute name.
aapl_id unused; lapl_id valid if non-default.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically supplied by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Aread
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aread(hid_t attr_id, hid_t type_id, void *buf);
functions.description: Reads the entire value of the attribute identified by attr_id into buf, converting to the in-memory datatype type_id as needed.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier opened for reading.
type_id must be a valid in-memory datatype identifier compatible with the attribute’s stored type for conversion.
buf must point to a writable buffer large enough to hold the converted attribute data.

functions.name: H5Aread_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aread_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t attr_id, hid_t dtype_id, void *buf, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously reads the attribute value into buf using in-memory datatype dtype_id. Operation completion is tracked by es_id; app_* identify the call site.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
dtype_id must be a valid in-memory datatype identifier compatible with the attribute.
buf must point to a writable buffer of sufficient size.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically supplied by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Arename
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Arename(hid_t loc_id, const char *old_name, const char *new_name);
functions.description: Renames an attribute on the object identified by loc_id from old_name to new_name.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier.
old_name must be the name of an existing attribute on the object.
new_name must be a valid new name for the attribute.

functions.name: H5Arename_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Arename_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *old_name, const char *new_name, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously renames an attribute on the object at loc_id from old_name to new_name. Completion is tracked by es_id; app_* identify the call site.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier.
old_name must exist; new_name must be a valid target name.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically provided by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Arename_by_name_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Arename_by_name_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *old_attr_name, const char *new_attr_name, hid_t lapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously renames an attribute on the object obj_name (relative to loc_id) from old_attr_name to new_attr_name, using lapl_id for link access. Completion is tracked by es_id.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object.
old_attr_name must be an existing attribute name; new_attr_name must be a valid new name.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically supplied by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Awrite
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Awrite(hid_t attr_id, hid_t type_id, const void *buf);
functions.description: Writes the entire value of the attribute identified by attr_id from buf, converting from the in-memory datatype type_id as needed.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier opened for writing.
type_id must be a valid in-memory datatype identifier compatible with the attribute’s stored type for conversion.
buf must point to readable memory containing the data to write.

functions.name: H5Awrite_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Awrite_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t attr_id, hid_t type_id, const void *buf, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronously writes an attribute’s value from buf using in-memory datatype type_id. Completion is tracked by es_id; app_* identify the call site.
requirements: attr_id must be a valid attribute identifier.
type_id must be a valid in-memory datatype identifier compatible with the attribute.
buf must point to readable memory containing the data to write.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
app_file, app_func, app_line are typically provided by the macro wrapper.

functions.name: H5Arename_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Arename_by_name(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, const char *old_attr_name, const char *new_attr_name, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Renames an attribute attached to the object at obj_name relative to loc_id from old_attr_name to new_attr_name, using lapl_id for link access.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location identifier.
obj_name must resolve to the target object (relative or absolute).
old_attr_name must name an existing attribute; new_attr_name must be a valid new name.
lapl_id must be a valid link access property list if non-default.

functions.name: H5Acreate1
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Acreate1(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t acpl_id);
functions.description: Deprecated. Creates an attribute named name attached to loc_id with datatype type_id and dataspace space_id. Returns an attribute identifier to be closed with H5Aclose. Prefer H5Acreate2.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier.
name must be unique on the target object and a valid string.
type_id and space_id must be valid and compatible.
acpl_id is present but documented as unused.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Aget_num_attrs
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Aget_num_attrs(hid_t loc_id);
functions.description: Deprecated. Returns the number of attributes attached to the object identified by loc_id. Prefer H5Oget_info* APIs.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier.

functions.name: H5Aiterate1
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Aiterate1(hid_t loc_id, unsigned *idx, H5A_operator1_t op, void *op_data);
functions.description: Deprecated. Iterates over attributes of the object identified by loc_id, starting at index *idx, calling user callback op for each attribute. Modifying attributes during iteration is undefined. Prefer H5Aiterate2.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier (group, dataset, or named datatype).
idx is the starting (input) and ending (output) attribute index; if NULL, all attributes are processed.
op must be a valid H5A_operator1_t callback and follow the documented return-value conventions (negative=failure, positive=short-circuit success, zero=continue).
Do not add or remove attributes during iteration; behavior is undefined.

functions.name: H5Aopen_idx
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen_idx(hid_t loc_id, unsigned idx);
functions.description: Deprecated. Opens the attribute at 0-based index idx attached to the object identified by loc_id. Returns an attribute identifier to be closed with H5Aclose. Prefer H5Aopen_by_idx.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier (group, dataset, or named datatype).
idx must be a non-negative 0-based index of an existing attribute.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Aopen_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Aopen_name(hid_t loc_id, const char *name);
functions.description: Deprecated. Opens the attribute named name attached to the object identified by loc_id. Returns an attribute identifier to be closed with H5Aclose. Prefer H5Aopen_by_name.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid object identifier.
name must be the name of an existing attribute on the object.
The returned attribute identifier must be closed with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Dcreate2
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dcreate2(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t lcpl_id, hid_t dcpl_id, hid_t dapl_id);
functions.description: Creates a new HDF5 dataset named name at location loc_id, with datatype type_id, dataspace space_id, and the specified link, creation, and access property lists (lcpl_id, dcpl_id, dapl_id). On success, returns an open dataset identifier ready for I/O.
requirements: loc_id must identify a valid location (file, group, dataset, named datatype, or attribute) where the dataset link is created.
name must be a valid path (absolute in file or relative to loc_id).
type_id must be a valid committed or transient datatype; committed types from a different file are copied/transiently converted.
space_id must be a valid dataspace describing the dataset on disk.
lcpl_id governs link creation and intermediate groups; must be a valid link creation property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied by convention though not explicitly stated).

dcpl_id must be a valid dataset creation property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied); creation options (layout, filters, chunking, fill value) must be consistent (e.g., chunking required for extendible datasets).
dapl_id must be a valid dataset access property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
Caller must close the returned dataset identifier with H5Dclose() when done.

functions.name: H5Dcreate_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dcreate_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t lcpl_id, hid_t dcpl_id, hid_t dapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Dcreate2 that schedules creation of a new dataset and associates the operation with an event set es_id. The first three parameters capture the application source location for debugging when used via the provided macro wrappers.
requirements: app_file, app_func, app_line are typically supplied by the wrapper macro and should describe the call site; values do not affect semantics.
loc_id, name, type_id, space_id, lcpl_id, dcpl_id, dapl_id must satisfy the same requirements as H5Dcreate2.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier for async operations.
Caller must close the returned dataset identifier with H5Dclose() when done.

functions.name: H5Dcreate_anon
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dcreate_anon(hid_t loc_id, hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t dcpl_id, hid_t dapl_id);
functions.description: Creates a new dataset in a file without creating a link to it. Returns a dataset identifier; the dataset must be linked into the file’s namespace with H5Olink() or it will be deleted when the file is closed.
requirements: loc_id must identify a valid location (file, group, dataset, named datatype, or attribute).
type_id must be a valid datatype describing on-disk representation.
space_id must be a valid dataspace for on-disk layout.
dcpl_id must be a valid dataset creation property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
dapl_id must be a valid dataset access property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
Caller must link the dataset into the file with H5Olink() before file close to persist it.
Caller must close the returned dataset identifier with H5Dclose() when done.

functions.name: H5Dopen2
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dopen2(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t dapl_id);
functions.description: Opens an existing dataset identified by name relative to loc_id and returns a dataset identifier for I/O.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid location (file, group, dataset, named datatype, or attribute) from which name is resolved.
name must identify an existing dataset at/under loc_id.
dapl_id must be a valid dataset access property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
Caller must close the returned dataset identifier with H5Dclose().

functions.name: H5Dopen_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dopen_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t dapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Dopen2 that schedules opening an existing dataset and associates it with event set es_id. First three parameters carry call-site info when invoked via wrappers.
requirements: app_file, app_func, app_line are call-site metadata (typically provided by macro).
loc_id must be a valid location and name must resolve to an existing dataset.
dapl_id must be a valid dataset access property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
Caller must close the returned dataset identifier with H5Dclose().

functions.name: H5Dget_space
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dget_space(hid_t dset_id);
functions.description: Returns an identifier for a copy of the dataspace of dataset dset_id. The returned dataspace should be closed by the caller.
requirements: dset_id must be a valid open dataset identifier.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose() to avoid leaks.

functions.name: H5Dget_space_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dget_space_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t dset_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Dget_space that schedules retrieval of the dataset’s dataspace and associates the operation with event set es_id. The first three parameters capture call-site metadata when invoked via wrappers.
requirements: app_file, app_func, app_line are call-site metadata (typically provided by macro).
dset_id must be a valid open dataset identifier.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose() when no longer needed.

functions.name: H5Dget_space_status
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dget_space_status(hid_t dset_id, H5D_space_status_t *allocation);
functions.description: Determines whether storage space has been allocated for dataset dset_id and stores the status in *allocation.
requirements: dset_id must be a valid open dataset identifier.
allocation must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the status.

functions.name: H5Dget_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dget_type(hid_t dset_id);
functions.description: Returns an identifier for a copy of the dataset’s datatype. If the dataset has a named (committed) datatype, returns an identifier to the opened datatype; otherwise returns a read-only transient copy.
requirements: dset_id must be a valid open dataset identifier.
Caller must close the returned datatype identifier when done (H5Tclose()).

functions.name: H5Dget_create_plist
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dget_create_plist(hid_t dset_id);
functions.description: Returns an identifier for a copy of the dataset creation property list for dataset dset_id.
requirements: dset_id must be valid.
Caller must close the returned property list with H5Pclose() to avoid leaks.

functions.name: H5Dget_access_plist
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Dget_access_plist(hid_t dset_id);
functions.description: Returns a copy of the dataset access property list used to open dataset dset_id, including resolved chunk cache settings. Modifications to the returned list do not affect the dataset.
requirements: dset_id must be valid.
Caller must close the returned property list with H5Pclose().

functions.name: H5Dget_storage_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL hsize_t H5Dget_storage_size(hid_t dset_id);
functions.description: Returns the amount of file storage, in bytes, allocated for the raw data of dataset dset_id (excludes metadata). For filtered chunked datasets, returns compressed size; for datasets with no stored values, returns 0. Note: return value 0 is ambiguous with error.
requirements: dset_id must be valid open dataset identifier.
Caller must not rely on return value alone to detect errors (0 may mean empty or error).

functions.name: H5Dget_chunk_storage_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dget_chunk_storage_size(hid_t dset_id, const hsize_t *offset, hsize_t *chunk_bytes);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes allocated in the file for the raw data chunk at the given logical chunk offset within dataset dset_id. For filtered chunks, this is the on-disk (e.g., compressed) size; size may be 0 if not allocated.
requirements: dset_id must refer to a chunked dataset.
offset must point to an array of length equal to the dataset rank, giving the logical position of the chunk’s first element (must be on a chunk boundary and within extent).
chunk_bytes must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the size.

functions.name: H5Dget_num_chunks
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dget_num_chunks(hid_t dset_id, hid_t fspace_id, hsize_t *nchunks);
functions.description: Retrieves the number of chunks with nonempty intersection with the selection fspace_id for dataset dset_id. As of noted versions, non-trivial selections are not supported; passing the dataset’s dataspace effectively returns the total number of stored chunks.
requirements: dset_id must refer to a dataset (intended for chunked datasets).
fspace_id should be a file dataspace selection; due to current limitations, it must be a dataspace obtained via H5Dget_space() to work around H5S_ALL handling issues.
nchunks must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the count.

functions.name: H5Dget_chunk_info_by_coord
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dget_chunk_info_by_coord(hid_t dset_id, const hsize_t *offset, unsigned *filter_mask, haddr_t *addr, hsize_t *size);
functions.description: Retrieves filter mask, on-disk size, and address for the chunk identified by logical element offset in dataset dset_id. If the chunk does not exist, sets size=0 and addr=HADDR_UNDEF; filter_mask is not modified in that case.
requirements: dset_id must refer to a chunked dataset.
offset must point to an array of length equal to the dataset rank indicating the chunk’s first element (must lie on a chunk boundary and within extent).
filter_mask, addr, and size can be NULL individually; non-NULL pointers will be filled as described.

functions.name: H5Dchunk_iter
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dchunk_iter(hid_t dset_id, hid_t dxpl_id, H5D_chunk_iter_op_t cb, void *op_data);
functions.description: Iterates over all chunks of a chunked dataset, invoking callback cb with chunk offset, filter mask, file address, and size for each chunk. Useful for inspecting chunk metadata/placement.
requirements: dset_id must refer to a chunked dataset opened in the file.
dxpl_id must be a valid data transfer property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
cb must be a valid function pointer; it controls iteration by its return value (0 continue, >0 stop, <0 error).
op_data may be NULL or a user context pointer.

functions.name: H5Dget_chunk_info
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dget_chunk_info(hid_t dset_id, hid_t fspace_id, hsize_t chk_idx, hsize_t *offset, unsigned *filter_mask, haddr_t *addr, hsize_t *size);
functions.description: Retrieves the offset (chunk origin coordinates), filter mask, on-disk size, and address for the chunk identified by index chk_idx within the (currently limited) selection for dataset dset_id. If the chunk does not exist, sets size=0 and addr=HADDR_UNDEF; filter_mask is not modified in that case.
requirements: dset_id must refer to a dataset with chunked storage.

fspace_id is intended to be the file dataspace selection; due to current limitations, non-trivial selections are not supported and H5S_ALL is not handled correctly, so applications should pass the dataset’s dataspace from H5Dget_space().
chk_idx must be in range [0, number_of_written_chunks_in_dataset).
offset, filter_mask, addr, and size may be NULL individually; non-NULL outputs will be filled as described.

functions.name: H5Dget_offset
functions.signature: H5_DLL haddr_t H5Dget_offset(hid_t dset_id);
functions.description: Returns the file address (byte offset from start of file) of the dataset’s raw data for contiguous datasets. Returns HADDR_UNDEF or a negative value on error or for non-applicable layouts.
requirements: dset_id must be a valid open dataset identifier.

functions.name: H5Dread
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dread(hid_t dset_id, hid_t mem_type_id, hid_t mem_space_id, hid_t file_space_id, hid_t dxpl_id, void *buf /*out*/);
functions.description: Reads data from dataset dset_id into application buffer buf. mem_type_id describes the memory datatype; mem_space_id and file_space_id describe the memory and file selections (H5S_ALL may be used as documented). The number of selected elements in memory and file must match.
requirements: dset_id must be a valid open dataset identifier.
buf must point to sufficient memory to hold all selected elements converted to mem_type_id.
mem_type_id must be a valid datatype describing the in-memory representation.
mem_space_id must be a valid dataspace or H5S_ALL; when not H5S_ALL, it defines both the memory dataspace and its selection.
file_space_id must be a valid dataspace or H5S_ALL; only its selection is used (the dataset’s dataspace is used for shape).
The number of elements selected in mem_space_id must equal the number selected in file_space_id.
dxpl_id must be a valid data transfer property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
Reading from an unallocated dataset with a defined fill value will fill buf with the fill value.

functions.name: H5Dread_multi
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dread_multi(size_t count, hid_t dset_id[], hid_t mem_type_id[], hid_t mem_space_id[], hid_t file_space_id[], hid_t dxpl_id, void *buf[] /*out*/);
functions.description: Reads from multiple datasets in a single call. Arrays of length count specify dataset IDs, memory datatypes, memory selections, file selections, and destination buffers. Semantics match performing count H5Dread calls, potentially enabling driver optimizations.
requirements: count must equal the lengths of all array parameters (dset_id, mem_type_id, mem_space_id, file_space_id, buf).
Each dset_id[i] must be a valid open dataset; all datasets must be in the same HDF5 file and each unique dataset must appear at most once.
If called collectively in parallel, each rank must pass exactly the same list (and order) of dataset IDs; other parameters may differ.
For each i, the number of elements selected in mem_space_id[i] must equal that in file_space_id[i].
Each buf[i] must point to sufficient memory for the corresponding selection with mem_type_id[i].
dxpl_id must be a valid transfer property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).

functions.name: H5Dread_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dread_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t dset_id, hid_t mem_type_id, hid_t mem_space_id, hid_t file_space_id, hid_t dxpl_id, void *buf /*out*/, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Dread that schedules a read into buf and associates it with event set es_id. First three parameters carry call-site metadata used by wrappers.
requirements: app_file, app_func, app_line are call-site metadata (usually supplied by macro).
All H5Dread requirements on dset_id, mem_type_id, mem_space_id, file_space_id, dxpl_id, and buf apply.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.

functions.name: H5Dread_multi_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dread_multi_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, size_t count, hid_t dset_id[], hid_t mem_type_id[], hid_t mem_space_id[], hid_t file_space_id[], hid_t dxpl_id, void *buf[] /*out*/, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Dread_multi; schedules reading from multiple datasets and associates the operation set with es_id. First three parameters carry call-site metadata for wrappers.
requirements: app_file, app_func, app_line are call-site metadata (typically provided by macro).
All H5Dread_multi requirements apply to count and the arrays.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.

functions.name: H5Dwrite
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Dwrite(hid_t dset_id, hid_t mem_type_id, hid_t mem_space_id, hid_t file_space_id, hid_t dxpl_id, const void *buf);
functions.description: Writes data from application buffer buf to dataset dset_id. mem_type_id describes memory datatype; mem_space_id and file_space_id describe memory and file selections (H5S_ALL combinations as documented). For string types, ensure correct length is set in the datatype. Space allocation and fill behavior depend on dataset properties.
requirements: dset_id must be a valid open dataset with write access to the file.
buf must point to at least as much data as selected elements require when converted from mem_type_id to the dataset’s on-disk type.
mem_type_id must be a valid datatype; for strings, set proper size (fixed or variable) via H5Tset_size().
mem_space_id must be a valid dataspace or H5S_ALL; when not H5S_ALL, it defines both memory dataspace and its selection.
file_space_id must be a valid dataspace or H5S_ALL; only its selection is used.
The number of elements selected in mem_space_id must equal the number in file_space_id.
dxpl_id must be a valid transfer property list or H5P_DEFAULT (implied).
Parallel writes to compact-layout datasets must write identical data from all processes (data cached in memory).

functions.name: H5Dwrite_multi
