functions.description: [Deprecated] Recursively visits objects starting from obj_id using legacy callback and fields mask controlling info population.
requirements: obj_id valid; idx_type/order valid
op callback valid; op_data passed through
fields combination of H5O_INFO_* flags
Group membership must remain unchanged during iteration

functions.name: H5Ovisit_by_name2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Ovisit_by_name2(hid_t loc_id, const char *obj_name, H5_index_t idx_type, H5_iter_order_t order, H5O_iterate1_t op, void *op_data, unsigned fields, hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: [Deprecated] Recursively visits object addressed by obj_name relative to loc_id using legacy callback with fields mask.
requirements: loc_id valid; obj_name identifies root
idx_type/order valid
op valid; op_data passed
fields combination of H5O_INFO_* flags
lapl_id H5P_DEFAULT or valid link access property list
Group membership must remain unchanged during iteration

functions.name: H5Pclose
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pclose(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Terminates access to a property list and frees associated resources. Use when finished with a property list created or obtained from the API.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list identifier returned by an H5P* create/copy/get call.
Each opened property list should be closed exactly once to avoid resource leaks.
Returns a negative value on error; callers should check the return value.

functions.name: H5Pclose_class
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pclose_class(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Closes a property list class identifier, removing the class from the library (no new lists of this class can be created after). Existing lists of that class remain valid.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list class identifier (not a list id).
After closing, do not reuse the class id.
Returns negative on error; callers must check.

functions.name: H5Pcopy
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pcopy(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Creates a new property list by copying an existing property list, including its properties and values.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list id.
On success returns a new property list id that must be closed with H5Pclose().
Returns a negative value on failure; check for < 0.

functions.name: H5Pcopy_prop
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pcopy_prop(hid_t dst_id, hid_t src_id, const char *name);
functions.description: Copies a named property between property lists or classes. If the property exists in the destination, it is deleted (invoking close callback, if any) before copying in the source (invoking copy/create callbacks as appropriate).
requirements: dst_id and src_id must both be either property list identifiers or property class identifiers; mixing list and class is allowed per docs for this routine (copy between list/class is supported).
name must be a non-NULL C string naming an existing property in the source.
If property does not exist in the destination, this behaves like registering/inserting it and may invoke create callback (for lists).
Returns negative on failure; check result.

functions.name: H5Pcreate
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pcreate(hid_t cls_id);
functions.description: Creates a new property list instance of the specified property list class (e.g., H5P_FILE_CREATE, H5P_DATASET_XFER, etc.). The new list is initialized with the class defaults.
requirements: cls_id must be a valid property list class identifier (e.g., H5P_FILE_CREATE).
The returned property list must be closed with H5Pclose().
Returns negative on failure; check return value.

functions.name: H5Pcreate_class
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pcreate_class(hid_t parent, const char *name, H5P_cls_create_func_t create, void *create_data, H5P_cls_copy_func_t copy, void *copy_data, H5P_cls_close_func_t close, void *close_data);
functions.description: Registers a new property list class, optionally inheriting from a parent class, and sets optional class-level create/copy/close callbacks. Returns a class id for creating lists of this class.
requirements: parent may be a valid property list class id or NULL to inherit from the default empty class.
name must be a non-NULL class name string.
Callback pointers may be NULL if not needed; corresponding user data pointers can be NULL.
The returned class id must be closed with H5Pclose_class() when no longer needed.
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pdecode
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pdecode(const void *buf);
functions.description: Decodes a property list from a binary buffer produced by H5Pencode* and returns a new property list identifier.
requirements: buf must point to a valid buffer containing an encoded property list created by H5Pencode1/2().
Some properties may not be encodable/decodable; such properties will be absent in the decoded list.
Returned id must be closed with H5Pclose().
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pencode2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pencode2(hid_t plist_id, void *buf, size_t *nalloc, hid_t fapl_id);
functions.description: Encodes the property values of plist_id into a binary buffer according to the libver bounds set in the file access property list fapl_id. If buf is NULL, returns the required buffer size in nalloc.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list id.
If buf is NULL, nalloc must be non-NULL; the routine will set required size and do no encoding.
If buf is non-NULL, the caller must ensure it is at least nalloc bytes; otherwise a crash may occur (per docs).
fapl_id controls encoding format via libver bounds; if missing, behaves as if (H5F_LIBVER_V18, H5F_LIBVER_LATEST).
Returns negative on failure; check return value.

functions.name: H5Pequal
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Pequal(hid_t id1, hid_t id2);
functions.description: Compares two property lists or two property classes for equality. Returns >0 for equal, 0 for not equal, and negative on error.
requirements: id1 and id2 must both be property lists or both be property classes; comparing a list to a class is an error.
Check for negative to detect errors; 0 means not equal, >0 means equal.

functions.name: H5Pexist
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Pexist(hid_t plist_id, const char *name);
functions.description: Checks whether a property with the given name exists in a property list or class.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list or class id.
name must be a non-NULL C string.
Returns >0 if exists, 0 if not, negative on error.

functions.name: H5Pget
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget(hid_t plist_id, const char *name, void *value);
functions.description: Retrieves (copies) the value of a named property from a property list into the caller-supplied buffer, invoking any registered get callback first.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list id (not a class id).
name must name an existing property in the list; otherwise the call fails.
value must point to a buffer of at least the property size (use H5Pget_size() to query). For zero-sized properties, value may be NULL.
If the get callback returns error, value is not modified.
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pget_class
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pget_class(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Returns the property list class identifier for a given property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list id.
Returned class id should be closed with H5Pclose_class() when no longer needed.
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pget_class_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL char *H5Pget_class_name(hid_t pclass_id);
functions.description: Allocates and returns the name string of a property list class. Caller must free the returned string with H5free_memory().
requirements: pclass_id must be a valid property list class id.
On success returns a heap-allocated string; free via H5free_memory().
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: H5Pget_class_parent
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pget_class_parent(hid_t pclass_id);
functions.description: Returns the identifier of the parent class for the given property list class.
requirements: pclass_id must be a valid property list class id.
Returned parent class id must be closed with H5Pclose_class().
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pget_nprops
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_nprops(hid_t id, size_t *nprops);
functions.description: Returns the number of properties in a property list or the number of registered properties in a property list class.
requirements: id must be a valid property list or property class id.
nprops must be non-NULL to receive the count.
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pget_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_size(hid_t id, const char *name, size_t *size);
functions.description: Retrieves the size in bytes of the value stored for a named property in a property list or class. Zero-sized properties return size 0.
requirements: id must be a valid property list or class id.
name must be a non-NULL property name existing in id.
size must be non-NULL to receive the size.
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pinsert2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pinsert2(hid_t plist_id, const char *name, size_t size, void *value, H5P_prp_set_func_t set, H5P_prp_get_func_t get, H5P_prp_delete_func_t prp_del, H5P_prp_copy_func_t copy, H5P_prp_compare_func_t compare, H5P_prp_close_func_t close);
functions.description: Registers a temporary (list-local) property in a property list with initial value and optional callbacks for set/get/delete/copy/compare/close. The property exists only in this list and its copies.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list id (not a class id).
name must not already exist in this list; otherwise the call fails.
value must point to initial value buffer of at least size bytes (may be NULL for zero-sized properties).
Callbacks may be NULL if not needed.
Zero-sized properties are allowed; for such, no data is stored and set/get are not applicable.
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Pisa_class
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Pisa_class(hid_t plist_id, hid_t pclass_id);
functions.description: Checks whether a property list is a member (instance) of a particular property list class.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list id.
pclass_id must be a valid property list class id.
Returns >0 if the list is of the class, 0 if not, negative on error.

functions.name: H5Piterate
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Piterate(hid_t id, int *idx, H5P_iterate_t iter_func, void *iter_data);
functions.description: Iterates over properties in a property list or class, invoking iter_func(name,...) for each property. Returns the last non-zero callback return or 0 when done; negative on failure.
requirements: id must be a valid property list or class id.
iter_func must be a valid callback of type herr_t (*)(hid_t id, const char *name, void *iter_data).
idx may be NULL to start at first property and not support restart; if non-NULL, contains start index and is updated to next index.
The set of properties must not be modified during iteration; behavior is undefined otherwise.

functions.name: H5Pregister2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pregister2(hid_t cls_id, const char *name, size_t size, void *def_value, H5P_prp_create_func_t create, H5P_prp_set_func_t set, H5P_prp_get_func_t get, H5P_prp_delete_func_t prp_del, H5P_prp_copy_func_t copy, H5P_prp_compare_func_t compare, H5P_prp_close_func_t close);
functions.description: Registers a permanent property with a property list class, defining its default value and optional lifecycle and access callbacks. All future lists of this class will include this property with the default value.
requirements: cls_id must be a valid property list class id.
name must be unique within the class; call fails if already registered.
def_value must point to a buffer at least size bytes; may be NULL for zero-sized properties.
create/set/get/prp_del/copy/compare/close callbacks may be NULL if not needed; see docs for semantics and allowed modifications.
Zero-sized properties are allowed. For such, create/close are called; set/get are not called.
Returns negative on failure.

functions.name: H5Premove
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Premove(hid_t plist_id, const char *name);
functions.description: Removes a property named 'name' from the property list identified by plist_id. If the property has a close callback, it is invoked before removal.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list identifier.
name must be the exact name of an existing property in the list; otherwise the call fails.

functions.name: H5Pset
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset(hid_t plist_id, const char *name, const void *value);
functions.description: Sets a new value for an existing property 'name' in property list plist_id. If a set callback is registered for the property, it is invoked and may modify the value before storage.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid property list identifier.
name must name an existing (non-zero-sized) property; zero-sized properties are not allowed here.
value must point to at least the size of the property value.

functions.name: H5Punregister
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Punregister(hid_t pclass_id, const char *name);
functions.description: Removes a property named 'name' from a property list class pclass_id. Affects only future lists created from the class, not existing lists.
requirements: pclass_id must be a valid property list class identifier.
name must be the name of a property registered with the class.

functions.name: H5Pall_filters_avail
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Pall_filters_avail(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Checks whether all filters set in a dataset or group creation property list are currently available in the library (built-in or loaded plugins).
requirements: plist_id must be a valid dataset or group creation property list.

functions.name: H5Pget_attr_creation_order
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_attr_creation_order(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *crt_order_flags);
functions.description: Retrieves flags indicating whether attribute creation order is tracked and/or indexed on the object creation property list (dataset/group creation).
requirements: plist_id must be an object creation property list (dataset or group).
crt_order_flags must be a valid pointer to receive flags.

functions.name: H5Pget_attr_phase_change
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_attr_phase_change(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *max_compact, unsigned *min_dense);
functions.description: Gets thresholds for switching attribute storage between compact and dense on an object creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be an object creation property list.
max_compact and min_dense must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_filter2
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5Z_filter_t H5Pget_filter2(hid_t plist_id, unsigned idx, unsigned int *flags, size_t *cd_nelmts, unsigned cd_values[], size_t namelen, char name[], unsigned *filter_config);
functions.description: Returns information about the filter at pipeline position idx in a dataset or group creation property list, including flags, client data, name, and filter config.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid dataset or group creation property list with filters.
idx must be in [0, N-1] where N is H5Pget_nfilters().
If name is non-NULL, namelen must be its allocated size; string may be unterminated if namelen too small.
cd_values must have at least *cd_nelmts entries; on return *cd_nelmts is set to actual count.
flags and filter_config may be NULL if not needed.

functions.name: H5Pget_filter_by_id2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_filter_by_id2(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_filter_t filter_id, unsigned int *flags, size_t *cd_nelmts, unsigned cd_values[], size_t namelen, char name[], unsigned *filter_config);
functions.description: Retrieves info for a specific filter_id present in a dataset or group creation property list, including flags, client data values, name, and config.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid dataset or group creation property list that includes filter_id.
cd_values must have capacity of at least *cd_nelmts; returns actual count in *cd_nelmts.
If name is non-NULL, provide namelen bytes; may be unterminated if too small.

functions.name: H5Pget_nfilters
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Pget_nfilters(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Returns the number of filters configured in the filter pipeline of a dataset or group creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid dataset or group creation property list.

functions.name: H5Pget_obj_track_times
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_obj_track_times(hid_t plist_id, bool *track_times);
functions.description: Queries whether an object creation property list is set to record object times (creation/modification/access).
requirements: plist_id must be an object creation property list.
track_times must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pmodify_filter
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pmodify_filter(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_filter_t filter, unsigned int flags, size_t cd_nelmts, const unsigned int cd_values[]);
functions.description: Modifies the parameters (flags and client data values) of an existing filter in a dataset or group creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid dataset or group creation property list containing the specified filter.
cd_values must point to at least cd_nelmts elements if cd_nelmts > 0.

functions.name: H5Premove_filter
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Premove_filter(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_filter_t filter);
functions.description: Removes the specified filter (or all filters if H5Z_FILTER_ALL) from the filter pipeline of a dataset or group creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a valid dataset or group creation property list.
filter must be H5Z_FILTER_ALL, a predefined filter, or a registered user filter present in the pipeline.

functions.name: H5Pset_attr_creation_order
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_attr_creation_order(hid_t plist_id, unsigned crt_order_flags);
functions.description: Configures attribute creation order tracking and/or indexing on an object creation property list (dataset/group).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset or group creation property list.
crt_order_flags is a bitwise OR of H5P_CRT_ORDER_TRACKED and/or H5P_CRT_ORDER_INDEXED; INDEXED requires TRACKED.

functions.name: H5Pset_attr_phase_change
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_attr_phase_change(hid_t plist_id, unsigned max_compact, unsigned min_dense);
functions.description: Sets thresholds controlling when attribute storage switches between compact and dense on an object creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset or group creation property list.
If max_compact == 0, dense storage is always used; then min_dense must be 0.
Otherwise max_compact >= min_dense.

functions.name: H5Pset_deflate
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_deflate(hid_t plist_id, unsigned level);
functions.description: Adds the gzip/deflate compression filter at given compression level (0–9) to a dataset or group creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset or group creation property list for a chunked dataset (datasets only) or allowable group usage.
level must be between 0 and 9 inclusive.
Applies only to chunked datasets; will fail for non-chunked datasets at dataset create/open time.

functions.name: H5Pset_filter
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_filter(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_filter_t filter, unsigned int flags, size_t cd_nelmts, const unsigned int cd_values[]);
functions.description: Appends a filter with the specified id, flags, and client data to the end of the filter pipeline for a dataset or group creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset or group creation property list.
For datasets, storage layout must be chunked; otherwise later create may fail.
cd_values must provide cd_nelmts entries if cd_nelmts > 0.
Use H5Z_FLAG_OPTIONAL or H5Z_FLAG_MANDATORY appropriately.

functions.name: H5Pset_fletcher32
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_fletcher32(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Enables the Fletcher32 checksum filter for a dataset or group creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset or group creation property list.
For datasets, layout must be chunked; checksum applies to chunks.

functions.name: H5Pset_obj_track_times
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_obj_track_times(hid_t plist_id, bool track_times);
functions.description: Sets whether created objects will have time fields recorded, via an object creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be an object creation property list.
track_times should be true to enable or false to disable.

functions.name: H5Pget_file_space_page_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_file_space_page_size(hid_t plist_id, hsize_t *fsp_size);
functions.description: Gets the file space page size used for paged aggregation/buffering in a file creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list (FCPL).
fsp_size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_file_space_strategy
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_file_space_strategy(hid_t plist_id, H5F_fspace_strategy_t *strategy, bool *persist, hsize_t *threshold);
functions.description: Retrieves the file space handling strategy, persistence flag, and section size threshold from a file creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Pointers provided must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_istore_k
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_istore_k(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *ik);
functions.description: Gets the B-tree 1/2 rank (ik) used for chunked dataset indexing from a file creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
ik must be a valid pointer if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_shared_mesg_index
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_shared_mesg_index(hid_t plist_id, unsigned index_num, unsigned *mesg_type_flags, unsigned *min_mesg_size);
functions.description: Retrieves configuration for a shared object header message index (types and min size) from a file creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
index_num selects the index (0-based) and must be within configured count.
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_shared_mesg_nindexes
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_shared_mesg_nindexes(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *nindexes);
functions.description: Gets the number of shared object header message indexes configured in a file creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
nindexes must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_shared_mesg_phase_change
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_shared_mesg_phase_change(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *max_list, unsigned *min_btree);
functions.description: Retrieves phase change thresholds for shared object header message index storage (list↔B-tree) from an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_sizes
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_sizes(hid_t plist_id, size_t *sizeof_addr, size_t *sizeof_size);
functions.description: Gets the on-disk byte sizes for offsets and lengths configured in a file creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
sizeof_addr/sizeof_size must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_sym_k
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_sym_k(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *ik, unsigned *lk);
functions.description: Retrieves the B-tree 1/2 rank and leaf node 1/2 size for symbol table nodes from an FCPL (legacy groups).
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
ik/lk must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_userblock
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_userblock(hid_t plist_id, hsize_t *size);
functions.description: Retrieves the user block size configured in a file creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_file_space_page_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_file_space_page_size(hid_t plist_id, hsize_t fsp_size);
functions.description: Sets the file space page size for paged aggregation/buffering in an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
fsp_size must be >= 512.
Once used to create a file, this setting cannot be changed for that file.

functions.name: H5Pset_file_space_strategy
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_file_space_strategy(hid_t plist_id, H5F_fspace_strategy_t strategy, bool persist, hsize_t threshold);
functions.description: Sets the file space handling strategy, persistence flag, and section threshold in an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Setting applies for the life of files created with this FCPL.
persist/threshold are ignored for strategies that don’t use FSM (e.g., AGGR/NONE).

functions.name: H5Pset_istore_k
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_istore_k(hid_t plist_id, unsigned ik);
functions.description: Sets the B-tree 1/2 rank used for chunked dataset indexing in an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
ik is half rank; (ik*2) must be <= 65536.

functions.name: H5Pset_shared_mesg_index
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_shared_mesg_index(hid_t plist_id, unsigned index_num, unsigned mesg_type_flags, unsigned min_mesg_size);
functions.description: Configures a shared object header message index’s allowed message types and minimum message size in an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
index_num must be < number of indexes configured via H5Pset_shared_mesg_nindexes().
mesg_type_flags must be a valid combination of H5O_SHMESG_* flags.

functions.name: H5Pset_shared_mesg_nindexes
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_shared_mesg_nindexes(hid_t plist_id, unsigned nindexes);
functions.description: Sets the number of shared object header message indexes in an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
nindexes must be <= H5O_SHMESG_MAX_NINDEXES (8).
If nindexes is 0, shared messages are disabled.

functions.name: H5Pset_shared_mesg_phase_change
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_shared_mesg_phase_change(hid_t plist_id, unsigned max_list, unsigned min_btree);
functions.description: Sets thresholds controlling list↔B-tree transitions for shared object header message index storage in an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
If max_list == 0, indexes are always B-tree and never revert.

functions.name: H5Pset_sizes
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_sizes(hid_t plist_id, size_t sizeof_addr, size_t sizeof_size);
functions.description: Sets the byte sizes for offsets and lengths used in files created with an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Valid sizes are 2, 4, 8, or 16; passing 0 retains current value.

functions.name: H5Pset_sym_k
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_sym_k(hid_t plist_id, unsigned ik, unsigned lk);
functions.description: Sets B-tree 1/2 rank and leaf node 1/2 size for symbol table nodes (legacy groups) in an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Passing 0 for a parameter leaves it unchanged.
(ik*2) must be <= 65536.

functions.name: H5Pset_userblock
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_userblock(hid_t plist_id, hsize_t size);
functions.description: Sets the user block size in an FCPL; must be 0 or a power of two ≥ 512.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
size must be 0 or a power of two >= 512.

functions.name: H5Pget_alignment
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_alignment(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t *threshold, hsize_t *alignment);
functions.description: Retrieves the alignment threshold and alignment values from a file access property list (FAPL).
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
Pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_cache
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_cache(hid_t plist_id, int *mdc_nelmts, size_t *rdcc_nslots, size_t *rdcc_nbytes, double *rdcc_w0);
functions.description: Gets legacy metadata cache element count (unused) and raw data chunk cache parameters (slots, size, preemption) from a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
mdc_nelmts is no longer used; other pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_core_write_tracking
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_core_write_tracking(hid_t fapl_id, bool *is_enabled, size_t *page_size);
functions.description: Retrieves core VFD write tracking settings (enabled and page size) from a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a FAPL configured for the core VFD via H5Pset_fapl_core().
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_driver
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pget_driver(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Returns the low-level VFD driver identifier set on a FAPL or DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access or data transfer property list.
Returned driver ID is valid while the driver remains registered and should be closed appropriately if duplicated.

functions.name: H5Pget_driver_info
functions.signature: H5_DLL const void *H5Pget_driver_info(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to driver-specific configuration struct for the VFD set on a FAPL or DXPL, or NULL if none.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access or data transfer property list.
Returned pointer refers to uncopied internal struct; treat as read-only.

functions.name: H5Pget_driver_config_str
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Pget_driver_config_str(hid_t fapl_id, char *config_buf, size_t buf_size);
functions.description: Retrieves a string representation of the VFD configuration on a FAPL. If config_buf is NULL, returns required length.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
If config_buf is non-NULL, it must have capacity buf_size; function returns length without NUL.

functions.name: H5Pget_elink_file_cache_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_elink_file_cache_size(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *efc_size);
functions.description: Gets the size (number of files) of the external link open file cache from a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
efc_size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_evict_on_close
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_evict_on_close(hid_t fapl_id, bool *evict_on_close);
functions.description: Gets the 'evict on close' metadata cache behavior flag from a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
evict_on_close must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_family_offset
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_family_offset(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t *offset);
functions.description: Retrieves the offset used with the FAMILY VFD from a FAPL to aid low-level access to a specific family member.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list configured for the FAMILY driver.
offset must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_fclose_degree
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_fclose_degree(hid_t fapl_id, H5F_close_degree_t *degree);
functions.description: Gets the file close degree policy from a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
degree must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_file_image
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_file_image(hid_t fapl_id, void **buf_ptr_ptr, size_t *buf_len_ptr);
functions.description: Retrieves a copy of the initial file image buffer and its size from a FAPL (used for in-memory file images).
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
If buf_ptr_ptr is non-NULL, the function allocates or uses callbacks to allocate a buffer; caller must free per callbacks or free().
buf_len_ptr, if non-NULL, receives required/actual size.

functions.name: H5Pget_file_image_callbacks
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_file_image_callbacks(hid_t fapl_id, H5FD_file_image_callbacks_t *callbacks_ptr);
functions.description: Retrieves file image callback function pointers set on a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
callbacks_ptr must be non-NULL and its fields initialized to NULL before the call.

functions.name: H5Pget_file_locking
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_file_locking(hid_t fapl_id, bool *use_file_locking, bool *ignore_when_disabled);
functions.description: Gets the file locking behavior flags from a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_gc_references
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_gc_references(hid_t fapl_id, unsigned *gc_ref);
functions.description: Retrieves the flag indicating whether reference garbage collection is enabled in a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
gc_ref must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_libver_bounds
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_libver_bounds(hid_t plist_id, H5F_libver_t *low, H5F_libver_t *high);
functions.description: Gets the library version bounds (low/high) used to control object format versions for file creation, from a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
low/high must be valid pointers.

functions.name: H5Pget_mdc_config
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_mdc_config(hid_t plist_id, H5AC_cache_config_t *config_ptr);
functions.description: Retrieves the initial metadata cache configuration from a FAPL into the provided H5AC_cache_config_t struct.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
config_ptr->version must be initialized to the correct struct version before the call.

functions.name: H5Pget_mdc_image_config
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_mdc_image_config(hid_t plist_id, H5AC_cache_image_config_t *config_ptr);
functions.description: Retrieves metadata cache image configuration from a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
config_ptr must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_mdc_log_options
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_mdc_log_options(hid_t plist_id, bool *is_enabled, char *location, size_t *location_size, bool *start_on_access);
functions.description: Gets metadata cache logging options from a FAPL: enabled flag, location path, size of location, and start-on-access flag.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
If location is non-NULL, *location_size must contain capacity; function sets/returns size via location_size.
Other pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_meta_block_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_meta_block_size(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t *size);
functions.description: Returns the minimum size for aggregated metadata block allocations from a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_metadata_read_attempts
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_metadata_read_attempts(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *attempts);
functions.description: Gets the configured number of attempts to read checksummed metadata (mainly for SWMR) from a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
attempts must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_multi_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_multi_type(hid_t fapl_id, H5FD_mem_t *type);
functions.description: Retrieves the MULTI VFD 'type of data' selection from a FAPL or DXPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a FAPL or DXPL configured for MULTI driver.
type must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_object_flush_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_object_flush_cb(hid_t plist_id, H5F_flush_cb_t *func, void **udata);
functions.description: Gets the object flush callback and user data set on a FAPL; invoked when an object flush occurs.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
func and udata must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_page_buffer_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_page_buffer_size(hid_t plist_id, size_t *buf_size, unsigned *min_meta_perc, unsigned *min_raw_perc);
functions.description: Returns page buffer settings (max size and min metadata/raw data percentages) from a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_sieve_buf_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_sieve_buf_size(hid_t fapl_id, size_t *size);
functions.description: Gets the maximum data sieve buffer size from a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_small_data_block_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_small_data_block_size(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t *size);
functions.description: Retrieves the small data block size setting from a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_vol_id
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_vol_id(hid_t plist_id, hid_t *vol_id);
functions.description: Returns the VOL connector ID set on a FAPL via H5Pset_vol; the returned ID should be closed with H5VLclose().
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
vol_id must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_vol_info
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_vol_info(hid_t plist_id, void **vol_info);
functions.description: Returns a copy of the VOL connector information associated with a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
vol_info must be a valid pointer; caller must free with connector-specific routine.

functions.name: H5Pset_alignment
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_alignment(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t threshold, hsize_t alignment);
functions.description: Sets object allocation alignment parameters on a FAPL: objects ≥ threshold are aligned to multiples of alignment (relative to user block end).
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
If file space strategy is PAGE, this property is ignored.
Use sensible alignment (often disk block size).

functions.name: H5Pset_cache
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_cache(hid_t plist_id, int mdc_nelmts, size_t rdcc_nslots, size_t rdcc_nbytes, double rdcc_w0);
functions.description: Sets global raw data chunk cache parameters for datasets in a file via the FAPL (slots, size, preemption).
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
mdc_nelmts is ignored.
rdcc_w0 must be in [0,1].
MPI I/O drivers in RW mode ignore raw chunk cache.

functions.name: H5Pset_core_write_tracking
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_core_write_tracking(hid_t fapl_id, bool is_enabled, size_t page_size);
functions.description: Configures core VFD write tracking on a FAPL to write only changed pages with optional page aggregation.
requirements: fapl_id must be a FAPL configured for the core VFD with backing store enabled.
If is_enabled is true, page_size must be > 0 (1 means no aggregation).

functions.name: H5Pset_driver
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_driver(hid_t plist_id, hid_t driver_id, const void *driver_info);
functions.description: Sets the VFD driver and optional driver-specific info on a FAPL or DXPL, incrementing the driver's refcount; properties are copied into the list.
requirements: plist_id must be a FAPL or DXPL.
driver_id must be a registered VFD class ID.
driver_info must match the driver's expected struct (may be NULL).

functions.name: H5Pset_driver_by_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_driver_by_name(hid_t plist_id, const char *driver_name, const char *driver_config);
functions.description: Sets the VFD on a FAPL or DXPL by driver name and optional configuration string. Will auto-load plugins if necessary.
requirements: plist_id must be a FAPL or DXPL.
driver_name must name a registered or loadable VFD.
driver_config may be NULL or a driver-specific string.

functions.name: H5Pset_driver_by_value
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_driver_by_value(hid_t plist_id, H5FD_class_value_t driver_value, const char *driver_config);
functions.description: Sets the VFD on a FAPL or DXPL by driver value (ID enum) and optional configuration string, auto-loading if needed.
requirements: plist_id must be a FAPL or DXPL.
driver_value must correspond to a registered or loadable VFD.
driver_config may be NULL or driver-specific.

functions.name: H5Pset_elink_file_cache_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_elink_file_cache_size(hid_t plist_id, unsigned efc_size);
functions.description: Sets the external link open file cache size (number of files) on a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
efc_size 0 disables the cache; positive enables with given size.

functions.name: H5Pset_evict_on_close
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_evict_on_close(hid_t fapl_id, bool evict_on_close);
functions.description: Controls whether metadata for objects is evicted from cache when the object is closed (when not referenced elsewhere), set on a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.

functions.name: H5Pset_family_offset
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_family_offset(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t offset);
functions.description: Sets the byte offset used with the FAMILY VFD on a FAPL for low-level handle retrieval targeting a particular family member.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list configured for the FAMILY VFD.
offset is a byte offset within the logical HDF5 file.

functions.name: H5Pset_fclose_degree
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_fclose_degree(hid_t fapl_id, H5F_close_degree_t degree);
functions.description: Sets the file close degree policy (WEAK, SEMI, STRONG, DEFAULT) on a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
All opens of the same file must use the same close degree value.

functions.name: H5Pset_file_image
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_file_image(hid_t fapl_id, void *buf_ptr, size_t buf_len);
functions.description: Sets an initial file image buffer on a FAPL for creating/opening a file from memory via suitable VFDs.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
If buf_ptr is non-NULL, buf_len specifies its size; the library copies the buffer.
Caller must ensure lifetime of provided buffer if callbacks dictate.

functions.name: H5Pset_file_image_callbacks
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_file_image_callbacks(hid_t fapl_id, H5FD_file_image_callbacks_t *callbacks_ptr);
functions.description: Sets user callbacks on a FAPL for allocating/copying/freeing file image buffers. Must be set before any image is set.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
Fails if a file image is already set on the FAPL.
callbacks_ptr must describe malloc/memcpy/realloc/free semantics and optional udata handlers.

functions.name: H5Pset_file_locking
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_file_locking(hid_t fapl_id, bool use_file_locking, bool ignore_when_disabled);
functions.description: Overrides library-configured file locking behavior on a FAPL and whether to ignore when underlying system lacks locking.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
Environment variable HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING may override programmatic setting.

functions.name: H5Pset_gc_references
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_gc_references(hid_t fapl_id, unsigned gc_ref);
functions.description: Enables/disables garbage collection of references stored in the global heap via a FAPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
When enabled, applications must initialize reference structs to zero to avoid heap corruption.

functions.name: H5Pset_libver_bounds
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_libver_bounds(hid_t plist_id, H5F_libver_t low, H5F_libver_t high);
functions.description: Sets the library version bounds on a FAPL controlling allowable object format versions for created objects.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
low and high must be valid H5F_libver_t values with low <= high.
Using H5F_LIBVER_LATEST may limit backward compatibility.

functions.name: H5Pset_mdc_config
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_mdc_config(hid_t plist_id, H5AC_cache_config_t *config_ptr);
functions.description: Sets the initial metadata cache configuration on a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
config_ptr->version must be correctly set; configuration must pass library validation.

functions.name: H5Pset_mdc_log_options
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_mdc_log_options(hid_t plist_id, bool is_enabled, const char *location, bool start_on_access);
functions.description: Configures metadata cache logging on a FAPL: enable flag, log file location, and whether to start on access.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
On Windows, location must be ASCII.
location must remain valid through use or be copied by the library (implementation detail).

functions.name: H5Pset_meta_block_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_meta_block_size(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t size);
functions.description: Sets minimum raw metadata aggregation block size on a FAPL (when VFD supports aggregation).
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
size 0 disables metadata aggregation; default is 2048 bytes.

functions.name: H5Pset_metadata_read_attempts
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_metadata_read_attempts(hid_t plist_id, unsigned attempts);
functions.description: Sets how many times to retry reading checksummed metadata (primarily for SWMR access) on a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
attempts must be > 0; fails if attempts == 0.

functions.name: H5Pset_multi_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_multi_type(hid_t fapl_id, H5FD_mem_t type);
functions.description: Sets the data type selection for the MULTI VFD on a FAPL to target a specific member file class for low-level handle access.
requirements: fapl_id must be a FAPL configured for the MULTI VFD.
type must be a valid H5FD_mem_t value.

functions.name: H5Pset_object_flush_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_object_flush_cb(hid_t plist_id, H5F_flush_cb_t func, void *udata);
functions.description: Sets a callback on a FAPL to be invoked whenever an object flush occurs, with user data passed to the callback.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
func may be NULL to clear; udata is stored and passed as-is; ensure pointer validity.

functions.name: H5Pset_sieve_buf_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_sieve_buf_size(hid_t fapl_id, size_t size);
functions.description: Sets the maximum data sieve buffer size on a FAPL (read/write buffering for contiguous dataset I/O).
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
size 0 disables data sieving.

functions.name: H5Pset_small_data_block_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_small_data_block_size(hid_t fapl_id, hsize_t size);
functions.description: Sets the size of contiguous blocks reserved for small raw dataset data on a FAPL, enabling improved locality/performance.
requirements: fapl_id must be a file access property list.
size 0 disables the small data block mechanism.

functions.name: H5Pset_vol
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_vol(hid_t plist_id, hid_t new_vol_id, const void *new_vol_info);
functions.description: Sets the VOL connector and optional connector info on a FAPL for subsequent file operations.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
new_vol_id must be a registered VOL ID; corresponding vol_info must match connector expectations (may be NULL).

functions.name: H5Pget_vol_cap_flags
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_vol_cap_flags(hid_t plist_id, uint64_t *cap_flags);
functions.description: Queries capability flags of the VOL connector stack that would be used with the given FAPL (considering environment overrides).
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
cap_flags must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_mdc_image_config
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_mdc_image_config(hid_t plist_id, H5AC_cache_image_config_t *config_ptr);
functions.description: Sets metadata cache image creation/loading behavior on a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
config_ptr must be a valid pointer and configuration must satisfy library constraints (e.g., disabled in certain parallel contexts).

functions.name: H5Pset_page_buffer_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_page_buffer_size(hid_t plist_id, size_t buf_size, unsigned min_meta_per, unsigned min_raw_per);
functions.description: Sets page buffer size and min metadata/raw data percentages on a FAPL. Enables page buffering for paged file space strategy when size >= page size.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
If page strategy/page size incompatible, file open/create may fail (see notes: in newer versions, some cases are ignored or rounded).

functions.name: H5Pset_relax_file_integrity_checks
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_relax_file_integrity_checks(hid_t plist_id, uint64_t flags);
functions.description: Enables relaxation of certain integrity checks (e.g., unusual unused bits in numeric types) on a FAPL to avoid false errors on valid files.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
flags is a bitmask of H5F_RFIC_* values (e.g., H5F_RFIC_UNUSUAL_NUM_UNUSED_NUMERIC_BITS, H5F_RFIC_ALL).

functions.name: H5Pget_relax_file_integrity_checks
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_relax_file_integrity_checks(hid_t plist_id, uint64_t *flags);
functions.description: Retrieves the relaxed file integrity check flags from a FAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file access property list.
flags must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pfill_value_defined
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pfill_value_defined(hid_t plist, H5D_fill_value_t *status);
functions.description: Indicates whether a dataset creation property list defines a fill value and whether it’s default or user-defined.
requirements: plist must be a dataset creation property list (DCPL).
status must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_alloc_time
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_alloc_time(hid_t plist_id, H5D_alloc_time_t *alloc_time);
functions.description: Gets the dataset storage allocation timing policy from a DCPL (default/early/incremental/late).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
alloc_time must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_chunk
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Pget_chunk(hid_t plist_id, int max_ndims, hsize_t dim[]);
functions.description: Retrieves the chunk dimensions for a chunked layout dataset from a DCPL, returning the rank (<= max_ndims).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list with layout set to CHUNKED.
dim must have capacity for max_ndims entries.
max_ndims must be >= rank.

functions.name: H5Pget_chunk_opts
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_chunk_opts(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *opts);
functions.description: Gets edge chunk options from a DCPL (e.g., do not filter partial edge chunks).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
opts must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_dset_no_attrs_hint
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_dset_no_attrs_hint(hid_t dcpl_id, bool *minimize);
functions.description: Queries whether the DCPL hints the library to create minimized dataset object headers (expecting no attributes).
requirements: dcpl_id must be a dataset creation property list.
minimize must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_spatial_tree
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_virtual_spatial_tree(hid_t dcpl_id, bool *use_tree);
functions.description: Gets whether a VDS created with the DCPL will use a spatial tree to optimize mapping intersection checks.
requirements: dcpl_id must be a dataset creation property list.
use_tree must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_external
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_external(hid_t plist_id, unsigned idx, size_t name_size, char *name, HDoff_t *offset, hsize_t *size);
functions.description: Returns information about the idx-th external file configured via DCPL (name, offset, reserved size).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list configured for external storage.
idx must be < H5Pget_external_count().
If name is non-NULL, name_size is its capacity; name may not be NUL-terminated if too small.

functions.name: H5Pget_external_count
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Pget_external_count(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Returns the number of external files configured in a DCPL for external storage.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.

functions.name: H5Pget_fill_time
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_fill_time(hid_t plist_id, H5D_fill_time_t *fill_time);
functions.description: Retrieves when fill values are written (ifset/alloc/never) from a DCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
fill_time must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_fill_value
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_fill_value(hid_t plist_id, hid_t type_id, void *value);
functions.description: Gets the dataset fill value from a DCPL, converted to the datatype specified by type_id.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list with a defined (non-NULL) fill value; otherwise this call fails.
type_id must be a valid datatype convertible from the stored fill value datatype.
value must point to sufficient space for type_id.

functions.name: H5Pget_layout
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5D_layout_t H5Pget_layout(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Returns the storage layout type (COMPACT, CONTIGUOUS, CHUNKED, VIRTUAL) from a DCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_count
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_virtual_count(hid_t dcpl_id, size_t *count);
functions.description: Returns the number of VDS mappings configured in a DCPL.
requirements: dcpl_id must be a dataset creation property list for a virtual dataset.
count must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_dsetname
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Pget_virtual_dsetname(hid_t dcpl_id, size_t index, char *name, size_t size);
functions.description: Gets the source dataset name for the VDS mapping at 'index'. Returns length (without NUL).
requirements: dcpl_id must be a DCPL for a virtual dataset.
index must be < mapping count.
If name is non-NULL, size must be the buffer size; may be truncated.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_filename
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Pget_virtual_filename(hid_t dcpl_id, size_t index, char *name, size_t size);
functions.description: Gets the source file name for the VDS mapping at 'index'. Returns length (without NUL).
requirements: dcpl_id must be a DCPL for a virtual dataset.
index must be < mapping count.
If name is non-NULL, size must be the buffer size; may be truncated.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_srcspace
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pget_virtual_srcspace(hid_t dcpl_id, size_t index);
functions.description: Returns a dataspace ID for the source selection of the VDS mapping at 'index'.
requirements: dcpl_id must be a DCPL for a virtual dataset.
index must be < mapping count.
Returned dataspace ID must be closed by the caller.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_vspace
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pget_virtual_vspace(hid_t dcpl_id, size_t index);
functions.description: Returns a dataspace ID for the virtual selection of the VDS mapping at 'index'.
requirements: dcpl_id must be a DCPL for a virtual dataset.
index must be < mapping count.
Returned dataspace ID must be closed by the caller.

functions.name: H5Pset_alloc_time
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_alloc_time(hid_t plist_id, H5D_alloc_time_t alloc_time);
functions.description: Sets the dataset storage allocation timing policy in a DCPL (default/early/incremental/late).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
Incremental allocation not allowed for COMPACT layout; will error.

functions.name: H5Pset_chunk
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_chunk(hid_t plist_id, int ndims, const hsize_t dim[]);
functions.description: Sets the chunk dimensions for a dataset in a DCPL and sets layout to CHUNKED.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
ndims must equal the dataset rank; dim array must have ndims positive elements.
Chunk size must not exceed dataset size for fixed-size datasets; very large chunks upgrade file format and may affect compatibility.

functions.name: H5Pset_chunk_opts
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_chunk_opts(hid_t plist_id, unsigned opts);
functions.description: Sets edge chunk handling options in a DCPL (e.g., do not filter partial edge chunks).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
opts may include H5D_CHUNK_DONT_FILTER_PARTIAL_CHUNKS; enabling may make dataset unreadable by very old HDF5 versions.

functions.name: H5Pset_dset_no_attrs_hint
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_dset_no_attrs_hint(hid_t dcpl_id, bool minimize);
functions.description: Hints that datasets created with this DCPL will not have attributes, enabling minimized object headers.
requirements: dcpl_id must be a dataset creation property list.
This is a hint; attributes can still be added but may be appended via continuation messages (performance consideration).

functions.name: H5Pset_virtual_spatial_tree
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_virtual_spatial_tree(hid_t dcpl_id, bool use_tree);
functions.description: Configures whether a virtual dataset created with this DCPL constructs and uses a spatial tree to speed mapping intersection checks.
requirements: dcpl_id must be a dataset creation property list for VDS.
use_tree true enables, false disables; benefit depends on access pattern.

functions.name: H5Pset_external
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_external(hid_t plist_id, const char *name, HDoff_t offset, hsize_t size);
functions.description: Adds an external file segment to a DCPL’s external storage list with file 'name', byte offset, and reserved size.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
Call before H5Dcreate(); the files may be created later on write.
If size == H5F_UNLIMITED, it must be the last external segment; no further external files can be added.

functions.name: H5Pset_fill_time
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_fill_time(hid_t plist_id, H5D_fill_time_t fill_time);
functions.description: Sets when fill values are written to the dataset (ifset/alloc/never) in a DCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.

functions.name: H5Pset_fill_value
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_fill_value(hid_t plist_id, hid_t type_id, const void *value);
functions.description: Sets the dataset fill value in a DCPL; value is stored with datatype type_id (may be converted later).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
type_id must be a valid datatype; value may be NULL to mark fill value as undefined.
Application must provide a buffer sized for type_id.

functions.name: H5Pset_shuffle
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_shuffle(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Enables the byte-shuffle filter (H5Z_FILTER_SHUFFLE) in a DCPL to improve compression when combined with a compressor.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
Applies only to chunked datasets.

functions.name: H5Pset_layout
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_layout(hid_t plist_id, H5D_layout_t layout);
functions.description: Sets the dataset storage layout (COMPACT, CONTIGUOUS, CHUNKED, VIRTUAL) in a DCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
COMPACT layout has size limitations (~64KB raw data).
VIRTUAL layout expects VDS mappings to be set.

functions.name: H5Pset_nbit
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_nbit(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Enables the N-Bit filter (H5Z_FILTER_NBIT) in a DCPL for integer/float datatypes with precision/offset, potentially compressing significant bits.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
Applies only to chunked datasets.
Works with integer/float (and compounds/arrays of those) fields; other types pass through.

functions.name: H5Pset_scaleoffset
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_scaleoffset(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_SO_scale_type_t scale_type, int scale_factor);
functions.description: Enables the scale-offset filter (H5Z_FILTER_SCALEOFFSET) in a DCPL with given method and factor for integers or floats.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list.
Applies only to chunked datasets.
scale_type must be valid (e.g., H5Z_SO_FLOAT_DSCALE, H5Z_SO_INT).
For INT: scale_factor is MinBits (0 default compute or positive). For FLOAT DSCALE: scale_factor is decimal scale; ensure value ranges fit.

functions.name: H5Pset_szip
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_szip(hid_t plist_id, unsigned options_mask, unsigned pixels_per_block);
functions.description: Enables SZIP (or compatible libaec) compression in a DCPL with selected mode (EC or NN) and pixels per block.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset creation property list for a chunked dataset.
options_mask must include exactly one of H5_SZIP_EC_OPTION_MASK or H5_SZIP_NN_OPTION_MASK.
pixels_per_block must be even and ≤ H5_SZIP_MAX_PIXELS_PER_BLOCK (typically ≤32).
Datatype must be 8/16/32/64-bit integer or 32/64-bit float.

functions.name: H5Pset_virtual
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_virtual(hid_t dcpl_id, hid_t vspace_id, const char *src_file_name, const char *src_dset_name, hid_t src_space_id);
functions.description: Adds a mapping to a virtual dataset in a DCPL from selection vspace_id to selection src_space_id in a source dataset src_dset_name in src_file_name (supports printf-style patterns).
requirements: dcpl_id must be a dataset creation property list for a VDS.
vspace_id and src_space_id must be valid dataspaces with selections; must be compatible shapes.
src_file_name and src_dset_name may use printf-style tokens; then source selection must be fixed-size.

functions.name: H5Pget_append_flush
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_append_flush(hid_t dapl_id, unsigned dims, hsize_t boundary[], H5D_append_cb_t *func, void **udata);
functions.description: Retrieves append boundary sizes and the append-flush callback and user data from a dataset access property list (DAPL).
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
dims must not exceed the number set; boundary must have capacity dims if non-NULL.
func/udata must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_chunk_cache
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_chunk_cache(hid_t dapl_id, size_t *rdcc_nslots, size_t *rdcc_nbytes, double *rdcc_w0);
functions.description: Gets per-dataset raw data chunk cache settings from a DAPL. If not set, returns defaults from FAPL.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
Pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_efile_prefix
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Pget_efile_prefix(hid_t dapl_id, char *prefix, size_t size);
functions.description: Retrieves the external file prefix string from a DAPL for locating dataset external storage files. Returns length without NUL.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
If prefix is non-NULL, size is capacity; may be truncated; Windows requires ASCII.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_prefix
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Pget_virtual_prefix(hid_t dapl_id, char *prefix, size_t size);
functions.description: Gets the prefix to be prepended to VDS source file paths from a DAPL. Returns length without NUL.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
If prefix is non-NULL, size is capacity.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_printf_gap
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_virtual_printf_gap(hid_t dapl_id, hsize_t *gap_size);
functions.description: Gets the maximum number of missing printf-style source files/datasets tolerated when computing an unlimited VDS extent.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
gap_size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_virtual_view
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_virtual_view(hid_t dapl_id, H5D_vds_view_t *view);
functions.description: Gets whether a VDS view is FIRST_MISSING or LAST_AVAILABLE from a DAPL.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
view must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_append_flush
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_append_flush(hid_t dapl_id, unsigned ndims, const hsize_t boundary[], H5D_append_cb_t func, void *udata);
functions.description: Sets sizes that define append boundaries for a dataset and a callback to invoke when a boundary is reached; the dataset will be flushed after callback returns.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
ndims must equal dataset rank; boundary must have ndims entries; a boundary value of 0 disables for that dimension.
Only applies to chunked datasets with extendible dimensions; will be validated on create/open.

functions.name: H5Pset_chunk_cache
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_chunk_cache(hid_t dapl_id, size_t rdcc_nslots, size_t rdcc_nbytes, double rdcc_w0);
functions.description: Sets per-dataset raw data chunk cache parameters on a DAPL overriding FAPL settings for that dataset.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
rdcc_w0 must be in [0,1].

functions.name: H5Pset_efile_prefix
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_efile_prefix(hid_t dapl_id, const char *prefix);
functions.description: Sets the external file prefix path on a DAPL for locating dataset external storage files.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
On Windows, prefix must be ASCII.
If prefix starts with ${ORIGIN}, it is resolved relative to the HDF5 file.

functions.name: H5Pset_virtual_prefix
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_virtual_prefix(hid_t dapl_id, const char *prefix);
functions.description: Sets a prefix to be prepended to VDS source file paths on a DAPL.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
prefix must remain valid or be copied by the library; used when traversing VDS source files.

functions.name: H5Pset_virtual_printf_gap
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_virtual_printf_gap(hid_t dapl_id, hsize_t gap_size);
functions.description: Sets how many missing printf-style source files/datasets are tolerated when computing an unlimited VDS extent.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
gap_size >= 0; default 0.

functions.name: H5Pset_virtual_view
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_virtual_view(hid_t dapl_id, H5D_vds_view_t view);
functions.description: Sets the VDS view (FIRST_MISSING or LAST_AVAILABLE) for dataset access via a DAPL.
requirements: dapl_id must be a dataset access property list.
view must be a valid H5D_vds_view_t value.

functions.name: H5Pget_btree_ratios
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_btree_ratios(hid_t plist_id, double *left, double *middle, double *right);
functions.description: Gets B-tree split ratios (left, middle, right) from a dataset transfer property list (DXPL).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
Pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_buffer
functions.signature: H5_DLL size_t H5Pget_buffer(hid_t plist_id, void **tconv, void **bkg);
functions.description: Gets the max size of type-conversion/background buffers and pointers set via H5Pset_buffer() on a DXPL; returns size in bytes (0 on failure).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
tconv/bkg receive previously set application-allocated buffer pointers; may be NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_data_transform
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Pget_data_transform(hid_t plist_id, char *expression, size_t size);
functions.description: Retrieves the data transform expression from a DXPL; returns expression length (without NUL).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
If expression is non-NULL, size specifies buffer capacity; may truncate.

functions.name: H5Pget_edc_check
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5Z_EDC_t H5Pget_edc_check(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Returns whether error-detection (EDC) is enabled or disabled for reads in a DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.

functions.name: H5Pget_hyper_vector_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_hyper_vector_size(hid_t fapl_id, size_t *size);
functions.description: Gets the number of I/O vectors accumulated for hyperslab I/O in a DXPL.
requirements: fapl_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
size must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_preserve
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Pget_preserve(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Deprecated: Previously checked compound datatype field preservation status on a DXPL (now core functionality). Returns 1 or 0.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.

functions.name: H5Pget_type_conv_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_type_conv_cb(hid_t dxpl_id, H5T_conv_except_func_t *op, void **operate_data);
functions.description: Gets the user-defined datatype conversion exception callback and user data from a DXPL.
requirements: dxpl_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
op and operate_data must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_vlen_mem_manager
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_vlen_mem_manager(hid_t plist_id, H5MM_allocate_t *alloc_func, void **alloc_info, H5MM_free_t *free_func, void **free_info);
functions.description: Gets custom memory allocation/free callbacks and user infos for variable-length datatype memory management from a DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pset_btree_ratios
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_btree_ratios(hid_t plist_id, double left, double middle, double right);
functions.description: Sets B-tree split ratios on a DXPL. Ratios control distribution of children among nodes on split.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
left/middle/right must be in [0,1].

functions.name: H5Pset_buffer
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_buffer(hid_t plist_id, size_t size, void *tconv, void *bkg);
functions.description: Sets maximum size of type conversion and background buffers for I/O on a DXPL and optionally provides application-allocated buffers for those.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
size must be sufficient to hold at least a slice across all remaining dimensions (strip-mining constraint).
tconv/bkg may be NULL to let library allocate.
Background buffer needed for certain conversions.

functions.name: H5Pset_data_transform
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_data_transform(hid_t plist_id, const char *expression);
functions.description: Sets a data transform expression on a DXPL to be applied to data during reads/writes (e.g., x*scale).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
expression must be a valid null-terminated string using +,-,*,/ and parentheses; only integer/float datasets supported.

functions.name: H5Pset_edc_check
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_edc_check(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_EDC_t check);
functions.description: Enables or disables error-detection (e.g., Fletcher32) for reads in a DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
check must be H5Z_ENABLE_EDC or H5Z_DISABLE_EDC.

functions.name: H5Pset_filter_callback
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_filter_callback(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_filter_func_t func, void *op_data);
functions.description: Sets a user callback on a DXPL to handle filter failures during I/O (e.g., choose to continue or fail).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
func may be NULL to clear; op_data is passed through to callback.

functions.name: H5Pset_hyper_vector_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_hyper_vector_size(hid_t plist_id, size_t size);
functions.description: Sets the number of I/O vectors to accumulate for hyperslab I/O on a DXPL (performance tuning).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
size must be > 1; default is 1024.

functions.name: H5Pset_preserve
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_preserve(hid_t plist_id, bool status);
functions.description: Deprecated: Previously controlled compound field preservation on DXPL; now no effect.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.

functions.name: H5Pset_type_conv_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_type_conv_cb(hid_t dxpl_id, H5T_conv_except_func_t op, void *operate_data);
functions.description: Sets a user callback on a DXPL for handling datatype conversion exceptions during I/O, with user data.
requirements: dxpl_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
op may be NULL to clear; operate_data is stored and passed through.

functions.name: H5Pset_vlen_mem_manager
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_vlen_mem_manager(hid_t plist_id, H5MM_allocate_t alloc_func, void *alloc_info, H5MM_free_t free_func, void *free_info);
functions.description: Sets custom memory allocation/free callbacks and user infos for variable-length datatype allocations used by H5Dread/H5Dvlen_reclaim via a DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
alloc_func/free_func may be NULL to use system malloc/free; associated info pointers are ignored if function is NULL.

functions.name: H5Pset_dataset_io_hyperslab_selection
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_dataset_io_hyperslab_selection(hid_t plist_id, unsigned rank, H5S_seloper_t op, const hsize_t start[], const hsize_t stride[], const hsize_t count[], const hsize_t block[]);
functions.description: Defines or combines a hyperslab file selection on a DXPL for use when H5Dread/H5Dwrite is called with file dataspace H5S_PLIST.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
rank must be between 1 and H5S_MAX_RANK; start/stride/count/block arrays must have 'rank' entries.
op defines how to combine with existing selection (e.g., SET/OR/AND etc.).

functions.name: H5Pset_selection_io
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_selection_io(hid_t plist_id, H5D_selection_io_mode_t selection_io_mode);
functions.description: Requests selection I/O mode (DEFAULT/OFF/ON) on a DXPL to enable advanced I/O paths (e.g., collective I/O with type conversion or VFD vector/selection I/O).
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
selection_io_mode must be a valid enum value; actual behavior may fall back depending on conditions (see get_no_selection_io_cause).

functions.name: H5Pget_selection_io
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_selection_io(hid_t plist_id, H5D_selection_io_mode_t *selection_io_mode);
functions.description: Gets the selection I/O mode requested on a DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
selection_io_mode must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_no_selection_io_cause
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_no_selection_io_cause(hid_t plist_id, uint32_t *no_selection_io_cause);
functions.description: Reports bitmask causes why selection/vector I/O was not used on the last I/O with this DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list used for an I/O.
no_selection_io_cause must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_actual_selection_io_mode
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_actual_selection_io_mode(hid_t plist_id, uint32_t *actual_selection_io_mode);
functions.description: Reports which type(s) of raw data I/O (scalar, vector, selection) were actually performed during the last I/O with this DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list used for an I/O.
actual_selection_io_mode must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_modify_write_buf
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_modify_write_buf(hid_t plist_id, bool modify_write_buf);
functions.description: Allows the library to modify the application’s write buffer (e.g., in-place type conversion) for operations using this DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
When enabled, application must not assume the write buffer contents are preserved after the call.

functions.name: H5Pget_modify_write_buf
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_modify_write_buf(hid_t plist_id, bool *modify_write_buf);
functions.description: Gets the 'modify write buffer' setting from a DXPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a dataset transfer property list.
modify_write_buf must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_create_intermediate_group
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_create_intermediate_group(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *crt_intmd);
functions.description: Gets whether missing intermediate groups will be created in link/object creation operations using this link creation property list (LCPL).
requirements: plist_id must be a link creation property list.
crt_intmd must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_create_intermediate_group
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_create_intermediate_group(hid_t plist_id, unsigned crt_intmd);
functions.description: Sets whether to create missing intermediate groups automatically for link/object creation operations using this LCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a link creation property list.
crt_intmd > 0 enables, 0 disables.

functions.name: H5Pget_est_link_info
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_est_link_info(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *est_num_entries, unsigned *est_name_len);
functions.description: Gets estimated link count and average link name length settings from a group creation property list (GCPL).
requirements: plist_id must be a group creation property list.
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_link_creation_order
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_link_creation_order(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *crt_order_flags);
functions.description: Queries whether link creation order tracking/indexing is enabled in groups created with the given GCPL or FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a group or file creation property list.
crt_order_flags must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_link_phase_change
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_link_phase_change(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *max_compact, unsigned *min_dense);
functions.description: Gets thresholds for compact↔dense link storage conversion from a GCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a group creation property list.
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_local_heap_size_hint
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_local_heap_size_hint(hid_t plist_id, size_t *size_hint);
