functions.description: Gets the local heap size hint for original-style (pre-1.8) groups from a GCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a group creation property list.
size_hint must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_est_link_info
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_est_link_info(hid_t plist_id, unsigned est_num_entries, unsigned est_name_len);
functions.description: Sets estimated number of links and average link name length on a GCPL to tune initial storage sizing.
requirements: plist_id must be a group creation property list.
Estimates should be ≤ 64K each; set est_num_entries to 0 to force dense groups.

functions.name: H5Pset_link_creation_order
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_link_creation_order(hid_t plist_id, unsigned crt_order_flags);
functions.description: Enables tracking and/or indexing of link creation order for groups created with the GCPL or FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a group or file creation property list.
crt_order_flags: H5P_CRT_ORDER_TRACKED and optionally H5P_CRT_ORDER_INDEXED (requires TRACKED).

functions.name: H5Pset_link_phase_change
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_link_phase_change(hid_t plist_id, unsigned max_compact, unsigned min_dense);
functions.description: Sets thresholds controlling conversion between compact and dense link storage for groups created with a GCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a group creation property list.
Typical defaults: max_compact=8, min_dense=6.

functions.name: H5Pset_local_heap_size_hint
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_local_heap_size_hint(hid_t plist_id, size_t size_hint);
functions.description: Sets a size hint for the local heap for original-style groups via a GCPL to reduce fragmentation or overhead.
requirements: plist_id must be a group creation property list.
size_hint 0 lets library choose; otherwise pick based on expected links × avg name length.

functions.name: H5Pset_map_iterate_hints
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_map_iterate_hints(hid_t mapl_id, size_t key_prefetch_size, size_t key_alloc_size);
functions.description: Sets hints controlling H5Miterate() key prefetch count and initial key buffer allocation size on a map access property list (MAPL).
requirements: mapl_id must be a map access property list.
key_prefetch_size and key_alloc_size must be sensible non-zero sizes (implementation dependent).

functions.name: H5Pget_map_iterate_hints
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_map_iterate_hints(hid_t mapl_id, size_t *key_prefetch_size, size_t *key_alloc_size);
functions.description: Gets the map iterate hints (prefetch count and initial buffer size) from a MAPL.
requirements: mapl_id must be a map access property list.
Output pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_char_encoding
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_char_encoding(hid_t plist_id, H5T_cset_t *encoding);
functions.description: Retrieves the character encoding (ASCII or UTF-8) used for link or attribute names created with the given ACPL/LCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a link creation or attribute creation property list.
encoding must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_char_encoding
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_char_encoding(hid_t plist_id, H5T_cset_t encoding);
functions.description: Sets the character encoding (ASCII or UTF-8) for names created with an attribute or link creation property list.
requirements: plist_id must be an attribute or link creation property list.
encoding should be H5T_CSET_ASCII or H5T_CSET_UTF8 (extended charsets not supported).

functions.name: H5Pget_elink_acc_flags
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_elink_acc_flags(hid_t lapl_id, unsigned *flags);
functions.description: Gets the file access flags to use when opening target files of external links from a link access property list (LAPL).
requirements: lapl_id must be a link access property list.
flags must be a valid pointer; may be H5F_ACC_RDWR, H5F_ACC_RDONLY, or H5F_ACC_DEFAULT.

functions.name: H5Pget_elink_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_elink_cb(hid_t lapl_id, H5L_elink_traverse_t *func, void **op_data);
functions.description: Gets the external link traversal callback function and user data from a LAPL.
requirements: lapl_id must be a link access property list.
func/op_data must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pget_elink_fapl
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Pget_elink_fapl(hid_t lapl_id);
functions.description: Returns the FAPL to be used when opening external link target files as set on a LAPL; may return H5P_DEFAULT.
requirements: lapl_id must be a link access property list.
Returned property list ID, if not default, should be closed when done.

functions.name: H5Pget_elink_prefix
functions.signature: H5_DLL ssize_t H5Pget_elink_prefix(hid_t plist_id, char *prefix, size_t size);
functions.description: Gets the prefix to prepend to external link target paths from a LAPL; returns length without NUL.
requirements: plist_id must be a link access property list.
If prefix is non-NULL, size is its capacity.

functions.name: H5Pget_nlinks
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_nlinks(hid_t plist_id, size_t *nlinks);
functions.description: Gets the maximum number of soft/user-defined link traversals allowed before cycle detection aborts, from a LAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a link access property list.
nlinks must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pset_elink_acc_flags
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_elink_acc_flags(hid_t lapl_id, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Sets the file access flags to use when opening external link targets via a LAPL.
requirements: lapl_id must be a link access property list.
flags must be H5F_ACC_RDWR, H5F_ACC_RDONLY, or H5F_ACC_DEFAULT (use parent’s flag).

functions.name: H5Pset_elink_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_elink_cb(hid_t lapl_id, H5L_elink_traverse_t func, void *op_data);
functions.description: Sets a callback to be invoked before opening an external link target file; may adjust flags/FAPL or take custom actions.
requirements: lapl_id must be a link access property list.
func must conform to H5L_elink_traverse_t; op_data stored and passed through.
Note: file close degree set here will be ignored for external link opens (always WEAK).

functions.name: H5Pset_elink_fapl
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_elink_fapl(hid_t lapl_id, hid_t fapl_id);
functions.description: Sets the FAPL to be used for opening external link target files for traversals using this LAPL.
requirements: lapl_id must be a link access property list.
fapl_id must be a valid file access property list ID.

functions.name: H5Pset_elink_prefix
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_elink_prefix(hid_t plist_id, const char *prefix);
functions.description: Sets a prefix to prepend to external link target paths on a LAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a link access property list.
prefix must be a valid string; caller must ensure lifetime if library does not copy.

functions.name: H5Pset_nlinks
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_nlinks(hid_t plist_id, size_t nlinks);
functions.description: Sets the maximum number of soft/user-defined link traversals allowed before the library aborts traversal (cycle protection) on a LAPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a link access property list.
nlinks must be a positive integer.

functions.name: H5Padd_merge_committed_dtype_path
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Padd_merge_committed_dtype_path(hid_t plist_id, const char *path);
functions.description: Adds a suggested path to search for a matching committed datatype during H5Ocopy() when merge-committed-dtype option is enabled in the object copy property list (OCPYPL).
requirements: plist_id must be an object copy property list.
path must be a valid path string; memory allocation for internal copy must succeed.

functions.name: H5Pfree_merge_committed_dtype_paths
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pfree_merge_committed_dtype_paths(hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Clears all suggested search paths for merging committed datatypes from an object copy property list.
requirements: plist_id must be an object copy property list.

functions.name: H5Pget_copy_object
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_copy_object(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *copy_options);
functions.description: Gets the object copy flags set on an object copy property list, e.g., shallow, expand soft/ext links, expand refs, without attrs, merge committed dtype.
requirements: plist_id must be an object copy property list.
copy_options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: H5Pget_mcdt_search_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_mcdt_search_cb(hid_t plist_id, H5O_mcdt_search_cb_t *func, void **op_data);
functions.description: Retrieves the merge-committed-dtype search callback and user data from an object copy property list.
requirements: plist_id must be an object copy property list.
func/op_data must be valid pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pset_copy_object
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_copy_object(hid_t plist_id, unsigned copy_options);
functions.description: Sets flags controlling object copy behavior in an object copy property list (e.g., expand links/refs, omit attrs, shallow, merge committed dtype).
requirements: plist_id must be an object copy property list.
copy_options is a bitmask of H5O_COPY_* flags.

functions.name: H5Pset_mcdt_search_cb
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_mcdt_search_cb(hid_t plist_id, H5O_mcdt_search_cb_t func, void *op_data);
functions.description: Sets a callback on an object copy property list to control whether to continue/stop/abort searching for a matching committed datatype during H5Ocopy().
requirements: plist_id must be an object copy property list.
func must conform to H5O_mcdt_search_cb_t; op_data stored and passed through.
Callback may instruct to abort copy; application must handle potential partial file state.

functions.name: H5Pregister1
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pregister1(hid_t cls_id, const char *name, size_t size, void *def_value, H5P_prp_create_func_t prp_create, H5P_prp_set_func_t prp_set, H5P_prp_get_func_t prp_get, H5P_prp_delete_func_t prp_del, H5P_prp_copy_func_t prp_copy, H5P_prp_close_func_t prp_close);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Registers a permanent property with a property list class, including callbacks for create/set/get/delete/copy/close and a default value.
requirements: cls_id must be a property list class ID.
name must be unique within the class.
def_value must point to initial value (or NULL for zero-sized).
Callbacks may be NULL as allowed; create/close called for zero-sized properties.

functions.name: H5Pinsert1
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pinsert1(hid_t plist_id, const char *name, size_t size, void *value, H5P_prp_set_func_t prp_set, H5P_prp_get_func_t prp_get, H5P_prp_delete_func_t prp_delete, H5P_prp_copy_func_t prp_copy, H5P_prp_close_func_t prp_close);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Inserts a temporary property into a property list, with initial value and callbacks for set/get/delete/copy/close.
requirements: plist_id must be a property list ID.
name must not already exist in the list.
value must point to initial value (or NULL for zero-sized).

functions.name: H5Pencode1
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pencode1(hid_t plist_id, void *buf, size_t *nalloc);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Encodes a property list into a binary buffer. If buf==NULL, returns required size via nalloc.
requirements: plist_id must be a property list ID.
If buf is non-NULL, it must be large enough (nalloc can be queried first).
Only properties with encode callbacks are encoded; user-defined properties cannot be encoded.

functions.name: H5Pget_filter1
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5Z_filter_t H5Pget_filter1(hid_t plist_id, unsigned filter, unsigned int *flags, size_t *cd_nelmts, unsigned cd_values[], size_t namelen, char name[]);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Returns filter info by index from a DCPL/GCPL (older API).
requirements: Same as H5Pget_filter2 with older prototype; plist_id must have filters; filter index valid.
String and array buffer sizes must be sufficient for returned data.

functions.name: H5Pget_filter_by_id1
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_filter_by_id1(hid_t plist_id, H5Z_filter_t id, unsigned int *flags, size_t *cd_nelmts, unsigned cd_values[], size_t namelen, char name[]);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Returns info for a specific filter id from a DCPL/GCPL (older API).
requirements: plist_id must include the specified filter id.
Buffers must have sufficient size as indicated by *cd_nelmts and namelen.

functions.name: H5Pget_version
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_version(hid_t plist_id, unsigned *boot, unsigned *freelist, unsigned *stab, unsigned *shhdr);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves version numbers for various on-disk structures from an FCPL (superseded by H5Fget_info).
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Pointers must be valid if non-NULL.

functions.name: H5Pset_file_space
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pset_file_space(hid_t plist_id, H5F_file_space_type_t strategy, hsize_t threshold);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Older API mapping to H5Pset_file_space_strategy() to set file space strategy and threshold on an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Use H5Pset_file_space_strategy for new code.

functions.name: H5Pget_file_space
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Pget_file_space(hid_t plist_id, H5F_file_space_type_t *strategy, hsize_t *threshold);
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Older API mapping to H5Pget_file_space_strategy() to get file space strategy and threshold from an FCPL.
requirements: plist_id must be a file creation property list.
Use H5Pget_file_space_strategy for new code.

functions.name: H5Rcreate_object
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rcreate_object(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t oapl_id, H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr);
functions.description: Creates an object reference to the object named name located at loc_id, using the object access property list oapl_id, and writes it to ref_ptr. The resulting H5R_ref_t must later be released with H5Rdestroy().
requirements: loc_id must identify a location where name can be resolved (group, file, etc.).
name must be a valid object name located at loc_id.
oapl_id must be an object access property list of the same type as the referenced object (group, dataset, or committed datatype).
ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to H5R_ref_t for output.
On success, the caller must call H5Rdestroy(ref_ptr) to release resources.

functions.name: H5Rcreate_region
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rcreate_region(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t space_id, hid_t oapl_id, H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr);
functions.description: Creates a dataset region reference for the region described by space_id within the dataset named name at loc_id. Stores the reference into ref_ptr. The returned reference must be released with H5Rdestroy().
requirements: loc_id must identify a location where dataset name can be resolved.
name must be the name of a dataset at loc_id.
space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier whose selection defines the desired region.
oapl_id must be a dataset object access property list (same type as referenced object).
ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to H5R_ref_t for output.
On success, the caller must call H5Rdestroy(ref_ptr) to release resources.

functions.name: H5Rcreate_attr
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rcreate_attr(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, const char *attr_name, hid_t oapl_id, H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr);
functions.description: Creates a reference to the attribute attr_name attached to the object name located at loc_id, using oapl_id, and stores it in ref_ptr. The resulting reference must be released with H5Rdestroy().
requirements: loc_id must identify a location where object name can be resolved.
name must be a valid object name at loc_id.
attr_name must be the name of an attribute attached to the object indicated by name.
oapl_id must be an object access property list of the same type as the object that the referenced attribute is attached to (group, dataset, or committed datatype).
ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to H5R_ref_t for output.
On success, the caller must call H5Rdestroy(ref_ptr) to release resources.

functions.name: H5Rdestroy
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rdestroy(H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr);
functions.description: Releases resources associated with an H5R_ref_t that was previously created or copied. Use after H5Rcreate_object/region/attr or H5Rcopy.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a reference previously initialized by an H5R create/copy call.

functions.name: H5Rget_type
functions.signature: H5R_type_t H5Rget_type(const H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr);
functions.description: Returns the type of the given reference (H5R_OBJECT2, H5R_DATASET_REGION2, or H5R_ATTR). Legacy types H5R_OBJECT1 and H5R_DATASET_REGION1 are never returned for H5R_ref_t.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid H5R_ref_t reference.

functions.name: H5Requal
functions.signature: htri_t H5Requal(const H5R_ref_t *ref1_ptr, const H5R_ref_t *ref2_ptr);
functions.description: Compares two references and returns a positive value if they refer to the same target (object, region, or attribute), 0 if not equal, or a negative value on failure.
requirements: ref1_ptr and ref2_ptr must be non-NULL pointers to valid H5R_ref_t references.
Caller must check for negative return value to detect failure.

functions.name: H5Rcopy
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rcopy(const H5R_ref_t *src_ref_ptr, H5R_ref_t *dst_ref_ptr);
functions.description: Copies an existing reference from src_ref_ptr to dst_ref_ptr. The destination reference must later be released with H5Rdestroy().
requirements: src_ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid H5R_ref_t reference.
dst_ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to H5R_ref_t for output.
On success, the caller must call H5Rdestroy(dst_ref_ptr) to release resources.

functions.name: H5Ropen_object
functions.signature: hid_t H5Ropen_object(H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, hid_t oapl_id);
functions.description: Opens the object referenced by ref_ptr and returns an object identifier. Use appropriate close routine (e.g., H5Oclose or H5Dclose) when done.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid reference to an object, region, or attribute (object is opened; if region or attribute, the underlying object is opened).
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list identifier if used (for accessing external files); otherwise follow library defaults.
oapl_id must be an object access property list of the same type as the referenced object (group or dataset).
Caller must close the returned identifier with the appropriate close function.

functions.name: H5Ropen_object_async
functions.signature: hid_t H5Ropen_object_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, hid_t oapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Ropen_object. Opens the referenced object and returns an identifier, scheduling the operation on the event set es_id. The app_* parameters are automatically filled by wrapper macros in application builds.
requirements: app_file, app_func must be valid C strings describing call site; app_line is the call-site line number. (Normally supplied by macro wrapper; applications should use the wrapper macros.)
ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid reference.
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list if used.
oapl_id must be an object access property list matching the object type.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier for async operations.
Caller must close the returned identifier with the appropriate close function when the operation completes.

functions.name: H5Ropen_region
functions.signature: hid_t H5Ropen_region(H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, hid_t oapl_id);
functions.description: From a region reference, returns a new dataspace identifier matching the dataset’s dataspace with the selection set to the referenced region. Close with H5Sclose() when done.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid dataset region reference.
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list if used (can include file access to external files).
oapl_id must be a dataset object access property list.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().

functions.name: H5Ropen_region_async
functions.signature: hid_t H5Ropen_region_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, hid_t oapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Ropen_region. Returns a dataspace identifier representing the referenced region; scheduled on es_id. app_* parameters are provided by wrapper macros in application builds.
requirements: app_file, app_func must be valid strings and app_line a source line number (normally supplied by wrapper macros).
ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid dataset region reference.
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list if used.
oapl_id must be a dataset object access property list.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose() after completion.

functions.name: H5Ropen_attr
functions.signature: hid_t H5Ropen_attr(H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, hid_t aapl_id);
functions.description: Opens the attribute referenced by ref_ptr and returns an attribute identifier. Close the attribute with H5Aclose() when no longer needed.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid attribute reference.
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list if used (can enable access to external files).
aapl_id must be a valid attribute access property list.
Caller must close the returned attribute with H5Aclose().

functions.name: H5Ropen_attr_async
functions.signature: hid_t H5Ropen_attr_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, hid_t aapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous variant of H5Ropen_attr. Opens the referenced attribute; operation is scheduled on es_id. app_* parameters are normally supplied by wrapper macros.
requirements: app_file, app_func must be valid strings and app_line a source line number (normally provided by wrapper macros).
ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid attribute reference.
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list if used.
aapl_id must be a valid attribute access property list.
es_id must be a valid event set identifier.
Caller must close the returned attribute with H5Aclose() after completion.

functions.name: H5Rget_obj_type3
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rget_obj_type3(H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, H5O_type_t *obj_type);
functions.description: Given a reference, retrieves in obj_type the type of the referenced object. rapl_id may control access to external files.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid reference.
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list if used.
obj_type must be a non-NULL pointer for output.

functions.name: H5Rget_file_name
functions.signature: ssize_t H5Rget_file_name(const H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, char *name, size_t size);
functions.description: Retrieves the file name for the target of the reference. Returns the name length on success; negative on failure. If name is NULL, the required size may be queried (per common name-length conventions described in the docs).
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid reference.
If name is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer of at least size bytes; size includes space for the null terminator.
Caller must handle return value: negative indicates failure.

functions.name: H5Rget_obj_name
functions.signature: ssize_t H5Rget_obj_name(H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, hid_t rapl_id, char *name, size_t size);
functions.description: Retrieves an object name for the target of the reference. For region references, returns the name of the dataset containing the region; for attribute references, returns the name of the object the attribute is attached to. Returns length on success, 0 if no name, negative on failure.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid reference.
rapl_id must be a valid reference access property list if used (may be needed for external files).
If name is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer of at least size bytes; size includes space for the null terminator.
Caller must check for negative return to detect failure.

functions.name: H5Rget_attr_name
functions.signature: ssize_t H5Rget_attr_name(const H5R_ref_t *ref_ptr, char *name, size_t size);
functions.description: Retrieves the attribute name for an attribute reference. Returns the name length on success; negative on failure.
requirements: ref_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid attribute reference.
If name is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer of at least size bytes.

functions.name: H5Rget_obj_type1
functions.signature: H5G_obj_t H5Rget_obj_type1(hid_t id, H5R_type_t ref_type, const void *ref);
functions.description: Deprecated. Given an object or region reference stored in ref, returns the referenced object’s type as an H5G_obj_t. Superseded by H5Rget_obj_type2 or newer APIs.
requirements: id must be an identifier for either the dataset containing the reference object or the group containing that dataset.
ref_type must be a valid reference type (e.g., H5R_OBJECT or H5R_DATASET_REGION).
ref must point to a reference of the type indicated by ref_type.
Caller must handle negative return (H5G_UNKNOWN) on failure.

functions.name: H5Rdereference1
functions.signature: hid_t H5Rdereference1(hid_t obj_id, H5R_type_t ref_type, const void *ref);
functions.description: Deprecated. Opens the object referenced by ref (object or dataset region) and returns an identifier. Superseded by H5Ropen_object/H5Ropen_region and H5Rdereference2.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid identifier for an object in the file containing the referenced object (including a file identifier).
ref_type must be H5R_OBJECT or H5R_DATASET_REGION.
ref must point to a reference matching ref_type.
Caller must close the returned identifier with the appropriate close function.

functions.name: H5Rcreate
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rcreate(void *ref, hid_t loc_id, const char *name, H5R_type_t ref_type, hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Deprecated. Creates a reference of type ref_type to the object named name at loc_id; for dataset region references, the region is defined by space_id. The reference is written to the buffer pointed to by ref (whose concrete type depends on ref_type).
requirements: ref must be a non-NULL pointer to storage suitable for the reference type indicated by ref_type (e.g., hobj_ref_t for object, hdset_reg_ref_t for region).
loc_id must identify a location where name can be resolved.
name must be a valid object name at loc_id.
ref_type must be a valid reference type as listed in H5R_type_t.
If ref_type indicates a dataset region reference, space_id must be a valid dataspace with a defined selection; otherwise pass -1 for object references.

functions.name: H5Rget_obj_type2
functions.signature: herr_t H5Rget_obj_type2(hid_t id, H5R_type_t ref_type, const void *ref, H5O_type_t *obj_type);
functions.description: Given a reference in ref, retrieves in obj_type the type (H5O_type_t) of the referenced object. Supersedes H5Rget_obj_type1.
requirements: id must be an identifier for either the dataset containing the reference object or the group containing that dataset.
ref_type must be a valid reference type (see H5R_type_t).
ref must point to a reference of the indicated type.
obj_type must be a non-NULL pointer for output.

functions.name: H5Rdereference2
functions.signature: hid_t H5Rdereference2(hid_t obj_id, hid_t oapl_id, H5R_type_t ref_type, const void *ref);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of H5Ropen_* APIs. Opens the object or region referenced by ref and returns an identifier, using object access property list oapl_id appropriate to the object type.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid identifier for the HDF5 file containing the referenced object or for any object in that file.
oapl_id must be an object access property list of the same type as the referenced object (group, dataset, or datatype).
ref_type must be H5R_OBJECT or H5R_DATASET_REGION.
ref must point to a reference matching ref_type.
Caller must close the returned identifier with the appropriate close routine.

functions.name: H5Rget_region
functions.signature: hid_t H5Rget_region(hid_t dataset, H5R_type_t ref_type, const void *ref);
functions.description: From a dataset region reference ref, returns a copy of the referenced dataset’s dataspace with the selection set to the referenced region. Close with H5Sclose().
requirements: dataset must be a file identifier or an identifier for any object in the file containing the referenced region.
ref_type must be H5R_DATASET_REGION.
ref must point to a dataset region reference.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().

functions.name: H5Rget_name
functions.signature: ssize_t H5Rget_name(hid_t loc_id, H5R_type_t ref_type, const void *ref, char *name, size_t size);
functions.description: Deprecated. Retrieves a name for the object identified by ref. Returns length on success, 0 if no name, or negative on failure. For region references, returns the name of the object containing the region.
requirements: loc_id must be an identifier for the file containing the reference or for any object in that file.
ref_type must be a valid reference type (see H5R_type_t).
ref must point to an object or dataset region reference matching ref_type.
If name is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer of at least size bytes; size includes space for the null terminator.
Caller must check for negative return to detect failure.

functions.name: H5Sclose
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sclose(hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Releases and terminates access to a dataspace identifier. After closing, the identifier must not be used. Prevents resource leaks.
requirements: space_id must be a valid, open dataspace identifier.
After a successful call, space_id is invalid for further use.
Caller must check the return value for errors and handle them.

functions.name: H5Scombine_hyperslab
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Scombine_hyperslab(hid_t space_id, H5S_seloper_t op, const hsize_t start[], const hsize_t stride[], const hsize_t count[], const hsize_t block[]);
functions.description: Combines a hyperslab (start/stride/count/block) with the current selection of space_id using op, returning a new dataspace with the resulting selection. If the current selection is not a hyperslab it is treated as H5S_SEL_ALL. If stride or block is NULL, defaults of 1 are used.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
start, count (and block/stride if non-NULL) must each have at least rank elements, where rank is the rank of space_id.
stride values, if provided, must not be 0.
op must be a valid hyperslab selection operator (see H5Sselect_hyperslab()).
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().
Caller must check for failure if an invalid selection or parameters are provided.

functions.name: H5Scombine_select
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Scombine_select(hid_t space1_id, H5S_seloper_t op, hid_t space2_id);
functions.description: Combines two hyperslab selections (space1_id and space2_id) using op and returns a new dataspace whose extent is copied from space1_id and whose selection is the result.
requirements: space1_id and space2_id must be valid dataspaces with hyperslab selections.
op must be a valid hyperslab selection operator (see H5Sselect_hyperslab()).
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().

functions.name: H5Scopy
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Scopy(hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Creates and returns a new dataspace that is an exact copy of the given dataspace. The returned identifier must be closed with H5Sclose().
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().

functions.name: H5Screate
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Screate(H5S_class_t type);
functions.description: Creates a new dataspace of the specified class (H5S_SCALAR, H5S_SIMPLE, or H5S_NULL).
requirements: type must be one of H5S_SCALAR, H5S_SIMPLE, or H5S_NULL.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().

functions.name: H5Screate_simple
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Screate_simple(int rank, const hsize_t dims[], const hsize_t maxdims[]);
functions.description: Creates a new simple dataspace with the given rank, current dimension sizes (dims), and maximum sizes (maxdims). If maxdims is NULL, it is taken to be equal to dims. A maxdims entry may be H5S_UNLIMITED.
requirements: rank must be the number of dimensions of the dataspace and non-negative.
dims must point to an array of at least rank elements.
maxdims must be either NULL or point to an array of at least rank elements.
Each maxdims[i], if provided, must be >= dims[i].
Any dims[i] may be 0; such a dataspace contains no writable elements.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().

functions.name: H5Sdecode
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Sdecode(const void *buf);
functions.description: Decodes a binary dataspace description (as produced by H5Sencode1/2) and returns a new dataspace identifier. Supports null, scalar, and simple dataspaces; selection information for simple dataspaces is included.
requirements: buf must point to a valid binary encoding of a dataspace produced by H5Sencode1() or H5Sencode2().
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().

functions.name: H5Sencode2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sencode2(hid_t obj_id, void *buf, size_t *nalloc, hid_t fapl);
functions.description: Encodes a dataspace identified by obj_id into a binary buffer. If buf is NULL, returns the required buffer size via nalloc. Encoding behavior can be influenced by fapl’s libver_bounds property.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
nalloc must be non-NULL; on input it should contain the size of buf if buf is non-NULL; on output it receives the required/used size.
If buf is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer of at least *nalloc bytes.
fapl should be a valid file access property list; if missing libver_bounds, defaults to (EARLIEST,LATEST).
Caller must check the return value and use nalloc to size/retry if the buffer is too small.

functions.name: H5Sextent_copy
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sextent_copy(hid_t dst_id, hid_t src_id);
functions.description: Copies the extent (shape/class/size) from src_id to dst_id. This may change the dataspace type of dst_id.
requirements: dst_id and src_id must be valid dataspaces.
Caller must handle that dst_id’s class/type may change after the call.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sextent_equal
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Sextent_equal(hid_t space1_id, hid_t space2_id);
functions.description: Tests whether two dataspaces have equal extents (same class/shape/sizes). Returns positive for equal, zero for not equal, negative on error.
requirements: space1_id and space2_id must be valid dataspaces.
Caller must interpret htri_t correctly: >0 true, 0 false, <0 error.

functions.name: H5Sget_regular_hyperslab
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Sget_regular_hyperslab(hid_t spaceid, hsize_t start[], hsize_t stride[], hsize_t count[], hsize_t block[]);
functions.description: If the current selection is a regular hyperslab, retrieves its start/stride/count/block parameters. Returns positive if regular (and outputs values), zero if not, negative on error.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with a selection.
start, stride, count, and block must each point to arrays with at least rank elements.
Caller must interpret htri_t return value (>0 regular, 0 not regular, <0 error).

functions.name: H5Sget_select_bounds
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sget_select_bounds(hid_t spaceid, hsize_t start[], hsize_t end[]);
functions.description: Retrieves the bounding box of the current selection (inclusive start and opposite-corner end), including any selection offset. Fails on a none selection.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with a non-none selection.
start and end must each point to arrays with capacity for rank coordinates.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sget_select_elem_npoints
functions.signature: H5_DLL hssize_t H5Sget_select_elem_npoints(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Returns the number of element points in the current element (point) selection. Negative on error.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with an element selection.
Caller must handle negative return as error.

functions.name: H5Sget_select_elem_pointlist
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sget_select_elem_pointlist(hid_t spaceid, hsize_t startpoint, hsize_t numpoints, hsize_t buf[/*numpoints*/]);
functions.description: Retrieves numpoints element coordinates from the current element selection starting at index startpoint into buf, in iteration order. Coordinates are serialized as consecutive indices per point.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with an element selection.
buf must have capacity for numpoints * rank hsize_t values.
startpoint and numpoints specify a valid range within the selection; caller must ensure they do not exceed the number of element points.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sget_select_hyper_blocklist
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sget_select_hyper_blocklist(hid_t spaceid, hsize_t startblock, hsize_t numblocks, hsize_t buf[/*numblocks*/]);
functions.description: Retrieves numblocks hyperslab blocks starting at block index startblock from the current selection into buf. For each block, start coordinates are followed immediately by opposite-corner coordinates.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with a hyperslab selection.
buf must have capacity for numblocks * 2 * rank hsize_t values.
startblock and numblocks must designate a valid range within the selection’s blocks.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sget_select_hyper_nblocks
functions.signature: H5_DLL hssize_t H5Sget_select_hyper_nblocks(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Returns the number of hyperslab blocks in the current selection. Negative on error.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must handle negative return as error.

functions.name: H5Sget_select_npoints
functions.signature: H5_DLL hssize_t H5Sget_select_npoints(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Returns the number of elements in the current selection for any selection type. Negative on error.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must handle negative return as error.

functions.name: H5Sget_select_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5S_sel_type H5Sget_select_type(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Returns the current selection type for the dataspace (H5S_SEL_NONE, H5S_SEL_POINTS, H5S_SEL_HYPERSLABS, or H5S_SEL_ALL). Negative on error.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must handle negative/invalid return as error.

functions.name: H5Sget_simple_extent_dims
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Sget_simple_extent_dims(hid_t space_id, hsize_t dims[], hsize_t maxdims[]);
functions.description: Retrieves the sizes (dims) and maximum sizes (maxdims) of each dimension. Either or both output arrays may be NULL. Returns rank on success, negative on error.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace.
If provided, dims and/or maxdims must each have capacity for rank elements.
Caller must handle negative return as error.

functions.name: H5Sget_simple_extent_ndims
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Sget_simple_extent_ndims(hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Returns the rank (number of dimensions) of the dataspace. Negative on error.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must handle negative return as error.

functions.name: H5Sget_simple_extent_npoints
functions.signature: H5_DLL hssize_t H5Sget_simple_extent_npoints(hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Returns the total number of elements in the dataspace (product of dimensions). Negative on error.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must handle negative return as error.

functions.name: H5Sget_simple_extent_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5S_class_t H5Sget_simple_extent_type(hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Returns the dataspace class (H5S_SCALAR, H5S_SIMPLE, H5S_NULL). Returns H5S_NO_CLASS on error.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must handle H5S_NO_CLASS as error.

functions.name: H5Sis_regular_hyperslab
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Sis_regular_hyperslab(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Determines whether the current hyperslab selection is regular (i.e., representable by a single start/stride/count/block). Returns positive if regular, zero if not, negative on error.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with a selection.
Caller must interpret htri_t correctly (>0 true, 0 false, <0 error).

functions.name: H5Sis_simple
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Sis_simple(hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Determines whether a dataspace is simple. Currently all dataspaces are simple; may change when complex dataspaces are added. Returns positive if simple, zero if not, negative on error.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must interpret htri_t correctly (>0 true, 0 false, <0 error).

functions.name: H5Smodify_select
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Smodify_select(hid_t space1_id, H5S_seloper_t op, hid_t space2_id);
functions.description: Modifies the existing hyperslab selection in space1_id by applying op with the hyperslab selection in space2_id, storing the result back into space1_id.
requirements: space1_id and space2_id must be valid dataspaces with hyperslab selections.
op must be a valid hyperslab selection operator (see H5Sselect_hyperslab()).
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Soffset_simple
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Soffset_simple(hid_t space_id, const hssize_t *offset);
functions.description: Sets the selection offset for a simple dataspace. If offset is NULL, resets the offset to 0 in all dimensions. Allows moving the same-shaped selection within the extent without redefining it.
requirements: space_id must be a valid simple dataspace identifier.
If offset is non-NULL, it must point to an array with at least rank elements.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Ssel_iter_close
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Ssel_iter_close(hid_t sel_iter_id);
functions.description: Closes a dataspace selection iterator, releasing its state.
requirements: sel_iter_id must be a valid selection iterator identifier.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Ssel_iter_create
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Ssel_iter_create(hid_t spaceid, size_t elmt_size, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Creates and initializes a selection iterator for the current selection of the dataspace. Iteration order is row-major for ALL/hyperslab selections; for point selections, it is selection order unless H5S_SEL_ITER_GET_SEQ_LIST_SORTED is specified. Using H5S_SEL_ITER_SHARE_WITH_DATASPACE means the dataspace must not be modified or closed until the iterator is closed.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with a selection.
elmt_size is the size in bytes of each element in the selection.
flags must be a combination of documented flags: H5S_SEL_ITER_GET_SEQ_LIST_SORTED and/or H5S_SEL_ITER_SHARE_WITH_DATASPACE.
If H5S_SEL_ITER_SHARE_WITH_DATASPACE is set, the associated dataspace must not be modified or closed until the iterator is closed.
Caller must close the returned iterator with H5Ssel_iter_close().

functions.name: H5Ssel_iter_get_seq_list
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Ssel_iter_get_seq_list(hid_t sel_iter_id, size_t maxseq, size_t maxelmts, size_t *nseq, size_t *nelmts, hsize_t *off, size_t *len);
functions.description: Retrieves up to maxseq sequences of (offset,length) for the next elements in the iterator, with at most maxelmts elements total across sequences. Lengths are in bytes. Returns actual counts in nseq and nelmts. Subsequent calls continue iteration; nseq and nelmts become zero when exhausted.
requirements: sel_iter_id must be a valid selection iterator created by H5Ssel_iter_create().
nseq and nelmts must be non-NULL pointers to receive counts.
off and len must each point to arrays with capacity for at least maxseq entries.
maxseq and maxelmts control output limits and should reflect the capacity of off/len and intended element count.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Ssel_iter_reset
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Ssel_iter_reset(hid_t sel_iter_id, hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Resets a selection iterator back to its initial state so it can iterate again over the selection of the given dataspace.
requirements: sel_iter_id must be a valid selection iterator identifier.
space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier whose selection is to be iterated.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sselect_adjust
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sselect_adjust(hid_t spaceid, const hssize_t *offset);
functions.description: Shifts the current selection in the dataspace by subtracting the provided logical offset.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with a selection.
offset must point to an array of at least rank elements.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sselect_all
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sselect_all(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Selects the entire extent of the dataspace (sets selection type to H5S_SEL_ALL).
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sselect_copy
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sselect_copy(hid_t dst_id, hid_t src_id);
functions.description: Copies the full selection (including offset) from src_id to dst_id.
requirements: dst_id and src_id must be valid dataspaces.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sselect_elements
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sselect_elements(hid_t space_id, H5S_seloper_t op, size_t num_elem, const hsize_t *coord);
functions.description: Adds or sets a point (element) selection within the dataspace. coord is a serialized 2D array of size [num_elem][rank] of zero-based coordinates. Supported ops: H5S_SELECT_SET, H5S_SELECT_APPEND, H5S_SELECT_PREPEND.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
op must be one of H5S_SELECT_SET, H5S_SELECT_APPEND, or H5S_SELECT_PREPEND.
num_elem specifies the number of points to select; coord must reference at least num_elem*rank values.
Coordinates must be zero-based within the dataspace extent.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sselect_hyperslab
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sselect_hyperslab(hid_t space_id, H5S_seloper_t op, const hsize_t start[], const hsize_t stride[], const hsize_t count[], const hsize_t block[]);
functions.description: Selects a hyperslab region and combines it with the current selection using op. start/stride/count/block arrays must have length equal to rank. If stride is NULL, defaults to 1s; if block is NULL, defaults to 1s. Stride values of 0 are not allowed. Iteration order is row-major by default.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
start and count must point to arrays with at least rank elements.
stride, if non-NULL, must point to an array with at least rank elements and contain no zeros.
block, if non-NULL, must point to an array with at least rank elements.
op must be a valid hyperslab selection operator (H5S_SELECT_SET, H5S_SELECT_OR, H5S_SELECT_AND, H5S_SELECT_XOR, H5S_SELECT_NOTB, H5S_SELECT_NOTA).
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sselect_intersect_block
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Sselect_intersect_block(hid_t space_id, const hsize_t *start, const hsize_t *end);
functions.description: Checks whether the current selection intersects with the inclusive block defined by start and end coordinates. Returns positive if intersects, zero if not, negative on error.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace with a selection.
start and end must each point to arrays with at least rank elements; bounds are inclusive.
Caller must interpret htri_t correctly (>0 true, 0 false, <0 error).

functions.name: H5Sselect_none
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sselect_none(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Resets the selection to include no elements (H5S_SEL_NONE).
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sselect_project_intersection
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Sselect_project_intersection(hid_t src_space_id, hid_t dst_space_id, hid_t src_intersect_space_id);
functions.description: Computes the intersection of src_intersect_space_id with src_space_id and projects that intersection into a selection on dst_space_id, returning a dataspace with the projected selection.
requirements: src_space_id, dst_space_id, and src_intersect_space_id must be valid dataspace identifiers.
Caller must close the returned dataspace with H5Sclose().
Caller must check for errors on return.

functions.name: H5Sselect_shape_same
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Sselect_shape_same(hid_t space1_id, hid_t space2_id);
functions.description: Checks whether two selections have the same dimensionality and shape. Intended to verify that selections can be processed in a single operation. Returns positive if same, zero if not, negative on error.
requirements: space1_id and space2_id must be valid dataspaces with selections.
Caller must interpret htri_t correctly (>0 true, 0 false, <0 error).

functions.name: H5Sselect_valid
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Sselect_valid(hid_t spaceid);
functions.description: Verifies that the current selection lies within the dataspace extent, considering the current offset. Returns positive if valid, zero if not, negative on error.
requirements: spaceid must be a valid dataspace with a selection.
Caller must interpret htri_t correctly (>0 true, 0 false, <0 error).

functions.name: H5Sset_extent_none
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sset_extent_none(hid_t space_id);
functions.description: Resets the dataspace to type H5S_NULL with no extent information.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sset_extent_simple
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sset_extent_simple(hid_t space_id, int rank, const hsize_t dims[], const hsize_t max[]);
functions.description: Sets or resets the size (extent) of an existing dataspace to SIMPLE with the given rank, dims, and max arrays.
requirements: space_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
rank must be the desired number of dimensions.
dims must point to an array with at least rank elements specifying current sizes.
max must point to an array with at least rank elements specifying maximum sizes.
Each max[i] must be >= dims[i].
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Sencode1
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Sencode1(hid_t obj_id, void *buf, size_t *nalloc);
functions.description: Deprecated alias of the original H5Sencode. Encodes a dataspace to a binary buffer; if buf is NULL, returns required size in nalloc. Superseded by H5Sencode2().
requirements: obj_id must be a valid dataspace identifier.
nalloc must be non-NULL; on input it should contain the size of buf if buf is non-NULL; on output it receives required/used size.
If buf is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer of at least *nalloc bytes.
Caller must check return value for errors.

functions.name: H5Tcreate
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tcreate(H5T_class_t type, size_t size);
functions.description: Creates a new transient datatype of the specified class and size. Used for H5T_COMPOUND, H5T_OPAQUE, H5T_ENUM, and H5T_STRING. The returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose(). For variable-length strings, pass size = H5T_VARIABLE.
requirements: type must be one of: H5T_COMPOUND, H5T_OPAQUE, H5T_ENUM, or H5T_STRING (others are typically created via H5Tcopy).
If creating a variable-length string, size must be H5T_VARIABLE.
For fixed-length strings, size is bytes (should include space for null terminator if desired).
The returned hid_t must be released with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tcopy
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tcopy(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Creates a transient, modifiable copy of an existing datatype or of a dataset’s datatype if a dataset id is provided. The copy must be closed with H5Tclose().
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id, a predefined datatype, or a dataset id.
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tclose
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tclose(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Releases a datatype identifier. After closing, the id is invalid; further use is illegal.
requirements: type_id must be a valid open datatype id.
Must be called to avoid resource leaks.

functions.name: H5Tclose_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tclose_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t type_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous version of H5Tclose(), enqueues close of a datatype on an event set.
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.
es_id must be a valid event set id.
May be invoked via wrapper macros supplying app_file/app_func/app_line.

functions.name: H5Tequal
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Tequal(hid_t type1_id, hid_t type2_id);
functions.description: Determines whether two datatype identifiers refer to the same datatype. Returns positive for equal, 0 for not equal, negative on error.
requirements: type1_id and type2_id must be valid datatype ids.

functions.name: H5Tlock
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tlock(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Locks a datatype, making it read-only and non-destructible. Once locked, it cannot be unlocked. Typically used internally for predefined types.
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.
Once locked, the datatype cannot be modified or unlocked.

functions.name: H5Tcommit2
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tcommit2(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t type_id, hid_t lcpl_id, hid_t tcpl_id, hid_t tapl_id);
functions.description: Commits a transient datatype into a file at loc_id with the given name, creating a committed (named) datatype. Property lists control link creation, datatype creation, and access. Fails for empty compound or enum types.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid file or group id.
name must be a valid path (absolute or relative to loc_id).
type_id must be a transient datatype that can hold data (not empty compound/enum).
lcpl_id is a valid link creation property list (H5P_DEFAULT allowed).
tcpl_id is a valid datatype creation property list (H5P_DEFAULT allowed).
tapl_id is a valid datatype access property list (H5P_DEFAULT allowed).

functions.name: H5Tcommit_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tcommit_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t type_id, hid_t lcpl_id, hid_t tcpl_id, hid_t tapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous version of H5Tcommit2(), enqueues commit of a transient datatype into a file on an event set.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid file or group id.
name must be a valid path.
type_id must be a transient datatype that can hold data (not empty compound/enum).
lcpl_id/tcpl_id/tapl_id must be valid property list ids or H5P_DEFAULT.
es_id must be a valid event set id.

functions.name: H5Topen2
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Topen2(hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t tapl_id);
functions.description: Opens a committed datatype by name at a location and returns a datatype id. Must be closed with H5Tclose().
requirements: loc_id must be a valid file or group id.
name must identify an existing committed datatype.
tapl_id must be a valid datatype access property list id (H5P_DEFAULT allowed).
Returned id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Topen_async
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Topen_async(const char *app_file, const char *app_func, unsigned app_line, hid_t loc_id, const char *name, hid_t tapl_id, hid_t es_id);
functions.description: Asynchronous version of H5Topen2(), enqueues opening a committed datatype on an event set.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid file or group id.
name must identify an existing committed datatype.
tapl_id must be valid or H5P_DEFAULT.
es_id must be a valid event set id.
Returned id is delivered asynchronously; follow event set semantics.

functions.name: H5Tcommit_anon
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tcommit_anon(hid_t loc_id, hid_t type_id, hid_t tcpl_id, hid_t tapl_id);
functions.description: Commits a transient datatype to a file without linking it into the group hierarchy (anonymous commit). Must be linked later with H5Olink() or it will be deleted when the file is closed. Fails for empty compound or enum types.
requirements: loc_id must be a valid file or group id.
type_id must be a transient datatype that can hold data (not empty compound/enum).
tcpl_id must be a valid datatype creation property list id or H5P_DEFAULT.
tapl_id is reserved for future use; should be H5P_DEFAULT.

functions.name: H5Tget_create_plist
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tget_create_plist(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns a copy of the datatype creation property list associated with a datatype. Caller must close the returned property list with H5Pclose().
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.
Returned property list id must be closed with H5Pclose().

functions.name: H5Tcommitted
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Tcommitted(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns whether a datatype id refers to a committed (named) datatype (positive), a transient type (0), or error (negative).
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tencode
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tencode(hid_t obj_id, void *buf, size_t *nalloc);
functions.description: Encodes a datatype description into a binary buffer. If buf is NULL, returns required buffer size via nalloc. Otherwise writes encoding into buf if nalloc is large enough; if not, returns required size via nalloc without encoding.
requirements: obj_id must be a valid datatype id.
If buf is non-NULL, nalloc must point to the allocated buffer size on input and will be updated with needed size on output.
If buf is NULL, nalloc must be non-NULL to receive required size.

functions.name: H5Tdecode2
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tdecode2(const void *buf, size_t buf_size);
functions.description: Decodes a binary-encoded datatype description (from H5Tencode) and returns a new datatype id. Caller must close it with H5Tclose().
requirements: buf must point to a valid encoded datatype buffer.
buf_size must be the size in bytes of buf.
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tflush
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tflush(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Flushes all buffers associated with a committed datatype to disk (requests OS to flush system buffers as well).
requirements: type_id must be a valid committed datatype id.

functions.name: H5Trefresh
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Trefresh(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Clears and reloads buffers/metadata for a committed datatype from disk. Effectively evicts and reopens metadata, preserving the same id.
requirements: type_id must be a valid committed datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tinsert
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tinsert(hid_t parent_id, const char *name, size_t offset, hid_t member_id);
functions.description: Adds a member to a compound datatype at the specified byte offset with a unique member name and member datatype.
requirements: parent_id must be a valid compound datatype id (uncommitted/modifiable).
name must be unique within the compound datatype.
offset is the byte offset within the compound instance; must fit within the compound size.
member_id must be a valid datatype id for the member.

functions.name: H5Tpack
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tpack(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Recursively removes internal padding from a compound datatype to minimize space.
requirements: type_id must be a valid compound datatype id (modifiable).

functions.name: H5Tenum_create
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tenum_create(hid_t base_id);
functions.description: Creates a new enumeration datatype using the specified integer base datatype. Returns a new enum datatype id to be closed with H5Tclose().
requirements: base_id must be a valid integer datatype id.
Returned enum datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tenum_insert
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tenum_insert(hid_t type, const char *name, const void *value);
functions.description: Inserts a named member into an enum datatype with the specified value (of the enum’s base type). Both name and value must be unique within the enum.
requirements: type must be a valid enum datatype id.
name must be unique within the enum.
value must point to data of the enum’s integer base datatype (correct size as per H5Tget_size on base).

functions.name: H5Tenum_nameof
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tenum_nameof(hid_t type, const void *value, char *name, size_t size);
functions.description: Finds the symbol name corresponding to a given enum value and writes at most size bytes to name. Fails if the full name plus terminator do not fit (truncates without NUL and returns failure).
requirements: type must be a valid enum datatype id.
value must point to a value of the enum’s base type.
name must be a valid buffer if size > 0; size is in bytes and should be large enough to hold full name and NUL.

functions.name: H5Tenum_valueof
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tenum_valueof(hid_t type, const char *name, void *value);
functions.description: Finds the value corresponding to a named enum member and writes it to value using the enum’s base type.
requirements: type must be a valid enum datatype id.
name must match an existing enum member.
value must point to a buffer large enough for the base type (use H5Tget_size on base).

functions.name: H5Tvlen_create
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tvlen_create(hid_t base_id);
functions.description: Creates a variable-length (1D) array datatype with the given base datatype. Not for creating variable-length strings.
requirements: base_id must be a valid datatype id (any HDF5 type, including VL, compound, atomic).
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().
Cannot be used to create variable-length string types (use string APIs).

functions.name: H5Tarray_create2
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tarray_create2(hid_t base_id, unsigned ndims, const hsize_t dim[]);
functions.description: Creates a fixed-size array datatype from a base datatype with the given rank and per-dimension sizes.
requirements: base_id must be a valid datatype id for the elements.
ndims must be > 0 and <= H5S_MAX_RANK.
Each dim[i] must be > 0.
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tget_array_ndims
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Tget_array_ndims(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the rank (number of dimensions) of an array datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid array datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_array_dims2
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Tget_array_dims2(hid_t type_id, hsize_t dims[]);
functions.description: Retrieves sizes of the dimensions of an array datatype into dims and returns the number of dimensions.
requirements: type_id must be a valid array datatype id.
dims must be a buffer large enough to hold all dimension sizes (length at least rank).

functions.name: H5Tcomplex_create
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tcomplex_create(hid_t base_type_id);
functions.description: Creates a complex number datatype consisting of real and imaginary parts of the given floating-point base type.
requirements: base_type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tset_tag
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_tag(hid_t type, const char *tag);
functions.description: Associates a descriptive ASCII tag with an opaque datatype. Tag length is limited by H5T_OPAQUE_TAG_MAX (256 bytes).
requirements: type must be a valid opaque datatype id.
tag must be an ASCII string with length <= H5T_OPAQUE_TAG_MAX.

functions.name: H5Tget_tag
functions.signature: H5_DLL char *H5Tget_tag(hid_t type);
functions.description: Returns the tag string associated with an opaque datatype. The returned string is heap-allocated and must be freed by the caller.
requirements: type must be a valid opaque datatype id.
Caller must free the returned string.

functions.name: H5Tget_super
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tget_super(hid_t type);
functions.description: Returns the base datatype from which the specified type is derived (e.g., base of enum/array/VL/complex). Returned id must be closed with H5Tclose().
requirements: type must be a valid datatype id.
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tget_class
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_class_t H5Tget_class(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the datatype class of the specified datatype (e.g., H5T_INTEGER, H5T_FLOAT, H5T_STRING, etc.).
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tdetect_class
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Tdetect_class(hid_t type_id, H5T_class_t cls);
functions.description: Determines whether a datatype contains any sub-datatypes of the given class. Useful for recursively inspecting compound/array/VL types.
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.
cls must be a valid H5T_class_t value.

functions.name: H5Tget_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL size_t H5Tget_size(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of a datatype. For VL strings: size of char*; for VL sequences: size of hvl_t.
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_order
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_order_t H5Tget_order(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the byte order of an atomic datatype or H5T_ORDER_MIXED for compound types with mixed member orders; H5T_ORDER_NONE for types without an order (e.g., strings).
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_precision
functions.signature: H5_DLL size_t H5Tget_precision(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the number of significant bits of an atomic or derived-from-atomic datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id of appropriate kind (atomic or derived from atomic).

functions.name: H5Tget_offset
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Tget_offset(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the bit offset of the first significant bit of an atomic datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid atomic (or derived) datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_pad
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tget_pad(hid_t type_id, H5T_pad_t *lsb, H5T_pad_t *msb);
functions.description: Retrieves the least- and most-significant bit padding types for an atomic datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid atomic (or derived) datatype id.
lsb and msb must be valid pointers if padding info is desired.

functions.name: H5Tget_sign
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_sign_t H5Tget_sign(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the sign scheme for an integer datatype (H5T_SGN_NONE or H5T_SGN_2).
requirements: type_id must be a valid integer datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_fields
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tget_fields(hid_t type_id, size_t *spos, size_t *epos, size_t *esize, size_t *mpos, size_t *msize);
functions.description: Retrieves locations and sizes of sign, exponent, and mantissa bit fields for a floating-point datatype. Any output pointers may be NULL.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_ebias
functions.signature: H5_DLL size_t H5Tget_ebias(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the exponent bias of a floating-point datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_norm
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_norm_t H5Tget_norm(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the mantissa normalization scheme for a floating-point datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_inpad
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_pad_t H5Tget_inpad(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the internal padding type for unused bits of a floating-point datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_strpad
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_str_t H5Tget_strpad(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the string padding method for a string datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid string datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_nmembers
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Tget_nmembers(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the number of fields in a compound datatype or members in an enum datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid compound or enum datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_member_name
functions.signature: H5_DLL char *H5Tget_member_name(hid_t type_id, unsigned membno);
functions.description: Returns the name of a member of a compound or enum datatype by index. The returned string is allocated by the library; caller must free it (H5free_memory()).
requirements: type_id must be a valid compound or enum datatype id.
membno must be in range [0, H5Tget_nmembers(type_id)-1].
Caller must free the returned string with H5free_memory().

functions.name: H5Tget_member_index
functions.signature: H5_DLL int H5Tget_member_index(hid_t type_id, const char *name);
functions.description: Returns the index of a compound or enum member by name.
requirements: type_id must be a valid compound or enum datatype id.
name must match an existing member.

functions.name: H5Tget_member_offset
functions.signature: H5_DLL size_t H5Tget_member_offset(hid_t type_id, unsigned membno);
functions.description: Returns the byte offset of a member within a compound datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid compound datatype id.
membno must be in range [0, H5Tget_nmembers(type_id)-1].

functions.name: H5Tget_member_class
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_class_t H5Tget_member_class(hid_t type_id, unsigned membno);
functions.description: Returns the datatype class of a member of a compound datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid compound datatype id.
membno must be in range.

functions.name: H5Tget_member_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tget_member_type(hid_t type_id, unsigned membno);
functions.description: Returns a copy of the datatype of a specified member of a compound datatype. Caller must close the returned datatype with H5Tclose().
requirements: type_id must be a valid compound datatype id.
membno must be in range.
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tget_member_value
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tget_member_value(hid_t type_id, unsigned membno, void *value);
functions.description: Returns the value of an enum datatype member by index, written using the enum’s base type into value.
requirements: type_id must be a valid enum datatype id.
membno must be in range.
value must point to a buffer large enough for the base type.

functions.name: H5Tget_cset
functions.signature: H5_DLL H5T_cset_t H5Tget_cset(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns the character set (encoding) used by a string datatype (e.g., H5T_CSET_ASCII or H5T_CSET_UTF8).
requirements: type_id must be a valid string datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tis_variable_str
functions.signature: H5_DLL htri_t H5Tis_variable_str(hid_t type_id);
functions.description: Returns whether a datatype is a variable-length string (positive), not VL string (0), or error (negative).
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tget_native_type
functions.signature: H5_DLL hid_t H5Tget_native_type(hid_t type_id, H5T_direction_t direction);
functions.description: Returns an equivalent native memory datatype for the given datatype, optionally unwinding compound/array/enum/VL types to their native forms. Returned id must be closed with H5Tclose().
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id.
direction must be H5T_DIR_DEFAULT, H5T_DIR_ASCEND, or H5T_DIR_DESCEND.
Returned datatype id must be closed with H5Tclose().

functions.name: H5Tset_size
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_size(hid_t type_id, size_t size);
functions.description: Sets the total size in bytes for a datatype or H5T_VARIABLE for variable-length string types. Adjusts precision/offset as needed for numeric types; for strings, size includes terminator if desired.
requirements: type_id must be a valid datatype id (not committed).
For strings, size may be H5T_VARIABLE (only for string types) or a positive byte count (should include space for NUL if needed).
Function is not applicable to H5T_ENUM, H5T_ARRAY, H5T_VLEN (array), H5T_REFERENCE, or H5T_COMPLEX.
For compound types, new size must accommodate all members.

functions.name: H5Tset_order
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_order(hid_t type_id, H5T_order_t order);
functions.description: Sets the byte order of a datatype. Allowed values: H5T_ORDER_LE, H5T_ORDER_BE, H5T_ORDER_VAX, H5T_ORDER_NONE. H5T_ORDER_MIXED cannot be set explicitly.
requirements: type_id must be a valid (uncommitted) datatype id.
order must be one of H5T_ORDER_LE, H5T_ORDER_BE, H5T_ORDER_VAX, or H5T_ORDER_NONE.
For ENUM, set byte order before defining members.
For compound types, order is set per-member (call on member types).

functions.name: H5Tset_precision
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_precision(hid_t type_id, size_t prec);
functions.description: Sets the number of significant bits of an atomic datatype. May adjust offset and size to keep bits within bounds. For strings, precision must be a multiple of 8 and changes size accordingly. For complex types, sets precision of the base type.
requirements: type_id must be a valid atomic datatype id (or complex, applying to base).
prec must be appropriate (multiple of 8 for H5T_STRING).
For floating-point types, set fields (sign/exp/mantissa) appropriately when decreasing precision.

functions.name: H5Tset_offset
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_offset(hid_t type_id, size_t offset);
functions.description: Sets the bit offset of the first significant bit of an atomic datatype. May increase total size to avoid overflow. Strings must have offset 0. For complex, applies to base type.
requirements: type_id must be a valid atomic datatype id (or complex, applying to base).
offset must be consistent with precision/size; strings must use 0.

functions.name: H5Tset_pad
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_pad(hid_t type_id, H5T_pad_t lsb, H5T_pad_t msb);
functions.description: Sets least- and most-significant bit padding types for an atomic datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid atomic datatype id.
lsb and msb must be valid H5T_pad_t values (H5T_PAD_ZERO, H5T_PAD_ONE, or H5T_PAD_BACKGROUND).

functions.name: H5Tset_sign
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_sign(hid_t type_id, H5T_sign_t sign);
functions.description: Sets the sign scheme for an integer datatype (unsigned or two’s complement).
requirements: type_id must be a valid integer datatype id.
sign must be H5T_SGN_NONE or H5T_SGN_2.

functions.name: H5Tset_fields
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_fields(hid_t type_id, size_t spos, size_t epos, size_t esize, size_t mpos, size_t msize);
functions.description: Sets positions and sizes of the sign, exponent, and mantissa fields of a floating-point datatype. Fields must not overlap and must be within precision.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.
Fields (spos, epos, esize, mpos, msize) must fit within the current precision and not overlap.
Typically set size/precision/offset first unless reducing precision, in which case set fields before calling H5Tset_precision().

functions.name: H5Tset_ebias
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_ebias(hid_t type_id, size_t ebias);
functions.description: Sets the exponent bias for a floating-point datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.

functions.name: H5Tset_norm
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_norm(hid_t type_id, H5T_norm_t norm);
functions.description: Sets the mantissa normalization scheme for a floating-point datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.
norm must be a valid H5T_norm_t value (H5T_NORM_IMPLIED, H5T_NORM_MSBSET, or H5T_NORM_NONE).

functions.name: H5Tset_inpad
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_inpad(hid_t type_id, H5T_pad_t pad);
functions.description: Sets how unused internal significant bits are filled for a floating-point datatype.
requirements: type_id must be a valid floating-point datatype id.
pad must be a valid H5T_pad_t value.

functions.name: H5Tset_cset
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_cset(hid_t type_id, H5T_cset_t cset);
functions.description: Sets the character encoding for a string/character datatype (ASCII or UTF-8).
requirements: type_id must be a valid string/character datatype id.
cset must be a valid H5T_cset_t (commonly H5T_CSET_ASCII or H5T_CSET_UTF8).

functions.name: H5Tset_strpad
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tset_strpad(hid_t type_id, H5T_str_t strpad);
functions.description: Defines the padding method for fixed-length string datatypes (NULLTERM, NULLPAD, SPACEPAD). Affects conversion behavior when sizes differ.
requirements: type_id must be a valid string datatype id.
strpad must be a valid H5T_str_t value.

functions.name: H5Tconvert
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Tconvert(hid_t src_id, hid_t dst_id, size_t nelmts, void *buf, void *background, hid_t plist_id);
functions.description: Converts nelmts elements from src_id to dst_id in-place within buf. Optional background buffer supplies destination elements for merging (e.g., compound fields). Dataset transfer property list (plist_id) carries conversion-related properties (e.g., VL alloc info). buf must be large enough for the larger of source/destination sizes.
requirements: src_id and dst_id must be valid datatype ids.
nelmts is the number of elements in buf.
buf must be non-NULL and large enough to hold converted data (no resizing is performed).
background is optional; if provided for compound types, must hold nelmts of dst_id.
plist_id must be a valid dataset transfer property list id (H5P_DEFAULT allowed).

functions.name: H5Treclaim
functions.signature: H5_DLL herr_t H5Treclaim(hid_t type_id, hid_t space_id, hid_t plist_id, void *buf);
